items.title: Nexxen Expands TV Home Screen Advertising to Southeast Asia via Coolita Partnership
items.summary: Nexxen has partnered with Smart TV operating system Coolita to expand its TV Home Screen advertising inventory across Southeast Asia.
items.content: Nexxen announced the expansion of its "Nexxen TV Home Screen" advertising solution into Southeast Asia through a new partnership with Coolita, a Smart TV operating system. This integration allows advertisers to programmatically access native ad placements across more than 350 TV brands, including COOCAA, Skyworth, Panasonic, and Polytron. The move is designed to help advertisers reach viewers directly within the TV experience as Connected TV (CTV) usage grows in the region. By leveraging Nexxen's supply-side platform (SSP), the company aims to provide a more efficient, unified way for brands to manage their Smart TV reach.

items.title: Marimekko Launches Limited-Edition Shopper Bag Capsule with Comme des Garçons
items.summary: Marimekko has partnered with the Japanese fashion brand Comme des Garçons to release a limited-edition collection of shopper bags featuring iconic Marimekko prints.
items.content: The collaboration features four shopper bag models in two sizes, each adorned with historical Marimekko patterns created by various designers between 1963 and 2022. The selected prints include 'Petrooli' by Annika Rimala (1963), 'Ryijy' by Maija Louekari (2011), 'Vatruska' by Aino-Maija Metsola (2012), and 'Seppel' by Antti Kekki (2022). The collection is scheduled to be available for purchase starting December 1, 2026, in select international boutiques across Asia and Europe.

items.title: Diana Shipping Inc. Announces Leadership Changes
items.summary: Diana Shipping Inc. appointed Christos Tsakonas as Chief Investments and Strategy Officer and announced that President Ioannis Zafirakis will transition to an advisory role.
items.content: Diana Shipping Inc. has appointed Christos Tsakonas as its new Chief Investments and Strategy Officer, effective November 23, 2026. In this capacity, Mr. Tsakonas will oversee the company's investment strategy and financing activities, reporting directly to CEO Semiramis Paliou. Additionally, the company announced that President Ioannis Zafirakis will transition to an advisory role starting March 1, 2027.

items.title: Diana Shipping Inc. Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: Diana Shipping Inc. reported a net loss for the third quarter of 2026, primarily driven by $12.3 million in transaction-related costs from a withdrawn acquisition proposal, and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share.
items.content: Diana Shipping Inc. reported a net loss of $0.5 million and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $1.9 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to a net income of $7.2 million in the same period of 2025. The quarterly results were significantly impacted by $12.3 million in transaction-related expenses, including loan and commitment fees, which were expensed following the company's withdrawal of its acquisition proposal for Genco Shipping & Trading Limited. Despite the net loss, time charter revenues for the quarter rose to $61.1 million from $51.9 million in the prior-year period. Additionally, the company declared a cash dividend of $0.05 per common share, payable on December 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 9, 2026.

items.title: UB Corporate Finance and UB Asset Management Act as Advisors in Herantis Pharma Directed Issue
items.summary: United Bankers Plc subsidiaries, UB Corporate Finance Ltd and UB Asset Management Ltd, are serving as financial advisor and placing agent, respectively, for a directed share issue by Herantis Pharma.
items.content: UB Corporate Finance Ltd is acting as the financial advisor and UB Asset Management Ltd is acting as the placing agent for a directed share issue announced by Herantis Pharma on November 24, 2026. The transaction involves the issuance of 12,500,000 offer shares at a subscription price of EUR 1.20 per share. The involvement of these United Bankers subsidiaries facilitates the capital raise, which Herantis Pharma intends to use for the Phase 2 clinical trial of its drug candidate HER-096, as well as for general corporate purposes.

items.title: StealthGas Inc. Reports Third Quarter and Nine Months 2026 Financial and Operating Results
items.summary: StealthGas Inc. announced its unaudited financial and operating results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, reporting strong profitability.
items.content: StealthGas Inc. (NASDAQ: GASS) released its financial and operating results for the third quarter and nine months ending September 30, 2026. The company reported net income of $24.5 million for the third quarter, which corresponds to a basic earnings per share (EPS) of $0.65. This performance represents a 41.6% increase compared to the previous quarter. As a ship-owning company, StealthGas continues to serve the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sector of the international shipping industry.

items.title: Bayer Licenses Cancer Drug From China's Hansoh for Up to $3.25 Billion
items.summary: Bayer has entered into a global licensing agreement with Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group to develop and commercialize the cancer drug candidate HS-20122.
items.content: Bayer has secured a licensing deal with China's Hansoh Pharmaceutical Group for the experimental cancer drug HS-20122, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting solid tumors. Under the terms of the agreement, Bayer will pay $150 million upfront, with potential additional payments of up to $3.1 billion contingent upon development, regulatory, and commercial milestones, alongside future royalties. The deal grants Bayer exclusive rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize the drug candidate in markets outside of China and Taiwan. This partnership is part of a broader trend of Western pharmaceutical companies collaborating with Chinese firms to access new drug pipelines.

items.summary: Christian Dior SE has extended the age limit for its chairman position by ten years, allowing for a potential tenure extension.
items.content: The board of Christian Dior SE has approved an increase in the age limit for the chairman of the company by ten years. This governance change allows the current chairman, who is 77 years old, to potentially remain in his leadership role for an additional 18 years. The decision reflects a strategic adjustment to the company's leadership structure and succession planning.

items.title: L'Oréal Paris Launches 'Stand Up' Initiative with Ariana Greenblatt
items.summary: L'Oréal Paris has partnered with brand ambassador Ariana Greenblatt to highlight the impact of street harassment during the 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence.
items.content: To coincide with the 16 Days of Activism Against Gender-Based Violence, L'Oréal Paris has launched a campaign featuring its youngest-ever brand ambassador, 19-year-old Ariana Greenblatt. The initiative aims to spotlight the impact of street harassment and encourage younger generations to participate in the company's 'Stand Up' movement. This effort is part of the brand's ongoing commitment to addressing gender-based violence and promoting social awareness.

items.title: German Consortium Including Airbus to Develop 'Satcom BW 4' Military Satellite System
items.summary: A consortium comprising Rheinmetall, OHB, and Airbus is set to develop a 15-billion-euro military satellite communications system for the German Bundeswehr.
items.content: A consortium including Airbus, Rheinmetall, and OHB is expected to sign a contract in the coming weeks for the development of 'Satcom BW 4,' a military satellite communications system for the German Bundeswehr. The project, valued at approximately 15 billion euros including VAT and ten years of operational costs, involves the creation of a constellation of over 100 satellites in low Earth orbit. The system is intended to be fully operational by 2030, with a transitional phase utilizing Telesat satellites beginning in 2027. The project aims to provide real-time communication capabilities for military aircraft and drones.

items.title: BNP Paribas Financial Markets Discloses Trading Activity in DCC Energy plc Shares
items.summary: BNP Paribas Financial Markets, acting as an exempt principal trader, disclosed recent trading activity in DCC Energy plc shares in a client-serving capacity.
items.content: BNP Paribas Financial Markets, serving as an exempt principal trader connected to Energy Capital Partners and KKR, reported trading activity in DCC Energy plc shares for November 24, 2026. The firm disclosed the purchase of 77,393 shares and the sale of 10,422 shares, resulting in a net increase of 66,971 shares. These transactions were conducted in a client-serving capacity under Rule 38.5(a) of the Irish Takeover Rules. The disclosure was made to provide transparency regarding dealings by parties linked to potential bidders for the company.

items.title: Bulgari to Open New High Jewelry Laboratory in Rome
items.summary: LVMH's Bulgari maison is redeveloping a historic building in Rome's Eur district to house a new high jewelry laboratory, expected to open by 2028.
items.content: Bulgari, a maison under the LVMH group, has announced plans to establish a new high jewelry laboratory in Rome. The project involves the redevelopment of a historic building in the Eur district, originally designed by architect Ettore Rossi, which will be transformed into a hub for designers, artisans, and archives. The facility is expected to accommodate over 300 people, including approximately 80 new artisans, and will feature specialized production technologies and LEED Gold-certified sustainable infrastructure. This investment aims to consolidate the brand's high jewelry manufacturing capabilities and support the transfer of artisanal skills to new generations. The new site will replace the current high jewelry atelier in Rome, complementing the brand's existing Italian manufacturing network.

items.title: Eric Sprott Reports Disposition of Shares in Andean Precious Metals Corp.
items.summary: Eric Sprott, through Sprott Mining Inc., disclosed the sale of 143,100 common shares of Andean Precious Metals Corp.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, Eric Sprott announced that his entity, Sprott Mining Inc., sold 143,100 common shares of Andean Precious Metals Corp. The shares were sold over the Toronto Stock Exchange at an average price of approximately $4.0925 per share, for aggregate consideration of $585,636.75. Following this transaction, Mr. Sprott's beneficial ownership decreased from approximately 12.0% to 11.9% of the company's outstanding shares on a non-diluted basis. Mr. Sprott stated that the securities are held for investment purposes and that he may acquire or sell additional securities in the future.

items.title: BP Capital Markets Announces Indicative Tender Offer Results
items.summary: BP Capital Markets has released the indicative results of its tender offers for various series of Euro and GBP senior and hybrid notes.
items.content: BP Capital Markets announced the indicative results for its tender offers regarding several series of Euro and GBP senior and hybrid notes. The company expects to accept approximately €1.89 billion of EUR NC2029 Notes and £374.7 million of GBP NC2029 Notes, both exceeding the 75% threshold, which triggers an intent to redeem the remaining outstanding notes. Additionally, the company specified acceptance amounts for various other senior note series while rejecting others. Settlement for the accepted notes is expected on November 27, 2026.

items.title: Telesat Selected as Transitional Satellite Provider for German Bundeswehr
items.summary: The German military (Bundeswehr) plans to utilize Telesat's satellite services as a transitional solution while developing its own sovereign satellite communications network.
items.content: As part of the broader 'Satcom BW 4' project, the German Bundeswehr has identified Telesat as a transitional satellite provider. This arrangement will support German military communications while the country works toward establishing its own sovereign satellite constellation, which is expected to begin construction in the coming years. Telesat's role is framed as a temporary measure to maintain operational capabilities until the new domestic system is fully realized. The broader German project, involving a consortium of major aerospace and defense firms, is estimated to be valued at approximately 15 billion euros over a ten-year period, including operational costs.

items.title: UK Competition Regulator Fines IFF GBP85 Million for Illegal Collusion
items.summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has fined International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) and other industry peers a total of GBP85 million for participating in an illegal price-fixing cartel.
items.content: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has imposed fines totaling GBP85 million on International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF), along with industry peers Firmenich and Givaudan, for engaging in illegal collusion. The regulatory action follows an investigation into anti-competitive practices within the fragrance and flavor industry. This penalty represents a significant regulatory enforcement action against the company. The fine is part of a broader crackdown on cartel behavior in the sector.

items.title: Robert Half Canada Analysis Shows Increase in On-Site Job Postings
items.summary: Robert Half Canada's job posting analysis indicates that 84% of new Canadian job postings in the second quarter of 2026 were fully on-site, a significant increase from 63% at the end of 2025.
items.content: According to an analysis by Robert Half Canada, the proportion of new Canadian job postings requiring full on-site attendance rose to 84% in the second quarter of 2026, up from 63% at the end of 2025. The data highlights a shift in hiring practices toward office-based roles. Industry observers note that this trend presents challenges for skilled workers who may need to choose between their career opportunities and their place of residence. The findings were reported in the context of broader discussions regarding remote work trends and the potential legal risks associated with employers mandating a return to the office.

items.title: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk Face Lawsuits Over Rare Eye Condition Linked to GLP-1 Drugs
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk are facing legal action in the United States regarding potential risks of a rare eye condition associated with their GLP-1 receptor agonist medications.
items.content: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk are being sued in the United States over allegations that their GLP-1 medications are linked to non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a rare condition that can cause vision loss. The lawsuits follow recent regulatory scrutiny, as the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has indicated it will require safety labeling updates for the drug class due to the potential risk of NAION. While the FDA is currently in discussions with manufacturers regarding these label changes, the legal proceedings represent a new development in the ongoing safety discourse surrounding these widely used treatments.

items.title: TeraWulf CEO Paul Prager Addresses Market Selloff and Data Center Demand

items.content: TeraWulf CEO Paul Prager clarified that the recent decline in the company's share price is a result of broader technology market volatility rather than a decrease in demand for its data center infrastructure. While the company continues to position itself as a key player in the AI and high-performance computing (HPC) data center space, the report notes that its Muskie facility currently remains without a tenant. items.title: Formation Metals Inc. Confirms Gold Continuity and Appoints Senior Strategic Advisor
items.summary: Formation Metals Inc. reported positive exploration results at its N2 property and announced the appointment of Terry Salman as a Senior Strategic Advisor.
items.content: Formation Metals Inc. confirmed gold continuity 200 metres west of the historical A-Zone at its N2 property, reporting 1.18 g/t Au over 33 metres, including 7.79 g/t Au over 2.8 metres. items.title: Lucky Minerals Inc. Announces Corporate Rebranding, Board Appointment, and Project Update
items.summary: Lucky Minerals Inc. announced a proposed name change to Terravik Metals Corp., the appointment of Nikolas Perrault to its Board of Directors, and provided an update on its Prud'homme Property in Quebec.
items.content: Lucky Minerals Inc. has announced a strategic corporate transformation that includes a proposed rebranding to Terravik Metals Corp. As part of its governance updates, the company has appointed Nikolas Perrault to its Board of Directors. Additionally, the company provided an overview of its 100%-owned Prud'homme Property in northern Québec, a 109-claim polymetallic land position in the Labrador Trough. The company intends to apply modern geological and geophysical techniques to reassess the property's potential. The release also confirmed the scheduling of the company's upcoming Annual General Meeting.

items.title: Stratum Holdings and Ocean Power Technologies Advance Strategic Collaboration
items.summary: Stratum Holdings Corp. and Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. have entered an agreement to begin the first phase of evaluating offshore data center assets powered by renewable energy.
items.content: Stratum Holdings Corp. and Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. (OPT) have signed an agreement to initiate the first phase of a strategic collaboration to assess the feasibility of deploying offshore data center assets. The project aims to combine OPT's PowerBuoy® technology with Stratum's high-performance GPU infrastructure, including its NVIDIA B300 GPUs, to support edge AI inference and other computing applications. The feasibility assessment will evaluate technical and commercial requirements, such as power generation, thermal management, and platform integration, with the goal of leveraging the marine environment for renewable-powered AI computing. This agreement advances the companies' previous non-binding letter of intent announced in October 2026.

items.title: Alchemy Labs Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Alchemy Labs Inc. announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, highlighting business developments in its automotive and defense segments.
items.content: Alchemy Labs Inc. reported its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. The company, which specializes in nanotechnology-based protective coatings, noted the expansion of its ExoShield ULTRA Pro portfolio to over 40 vehicle models, including various brands such as Ford, GM, and Porsche. Management emphasized a continued focus on higher-margin products like the ExoShield GT3+ and ULTRA windshield protection lines, alongside pricing discipline. Additionally, the company reported progress in its Crypsis thermal signature management technology, including the completion of Phase 2 of an NRE program with a U.S. defense garment supplier and ongoing field trials with a Canadian defense textile manufacturer.

items.title: Vivakor, Inc. to Acquire Direct Midstream, LLC for $40 Million
items.summary: Vivakor, Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Direct Midstream, LLC in a transaction valued at $40 million.
items.content: The acquisition includes 17 saltwater disposal facilities and nine fresh water and brine stations, adding approximately 11.5 million barrels per month of permitted disposal capacity in the Permian Basin. The transaction is expected to expand Vivakor's midstream energy and fluid management capabilities, including oil reclamation and production operations. The deal follows the completion of due diligence and is subject to customary closing conditions.

items.title: Algo Grande Copper Reports Assay Results from Hole AG-CG-PH2-004 at Adelita Project
items.summary: Algo Grande Copper Corp. announced assay results from drill hole AG-CG-PH2-004 at the Cerro Grande target of its Adelita Project in Sonora, Mexico, which intersected five mineralized zones.
items.content: Algo Grande Copper Corp. has released assay results for hole AG-CG-PH2-004, drilled to a depth of 411.56 metres at the Cerro Grande target within the Adelita Project. The drilling program intersected five distinct mineralized zones. The company utilized a 0.2% copper equivalent (CuEq) cut-off for composites, with internal dilution limited to 5 metres. The reported results follow the technical disclosure standards established in the company's previous October 28, 2026, news release.

items.title: DGEN Technologies Corp. Completes Acquisition of Exclusive License to HumanOS Artificial Intelligence Technology
items.summary: DGEN Technologies Corp. has finalized its acquisition of an exclusive, irrevocable license to the AI software, automation technology, and related assets of HumanOS Technologies Inc.
items.content: DGEN Technologies Corp. announced the completion of its acquisition of an exclusive license to the artificial intelligence software and automation technology of HumanOS Technologies Inc. The transaction, which was previously announced, includes the rights to the HumanOS trade name, associated websites, and customer lists. As consideration, DGEN issued 4,000,000 common shares at a deemed price of $0.25 per share, totaling $1,000,000, along with 4,000,000 common share purchase warrants exercisable at $0.32 per share until November 23, 2029. The license allows DGEN to commercialize and further develop the acquired assets, while HumanOS retains ownership of the underlying technology. The consideration shares and warrants are subject to resale restrictions until March 24, 2027.

items.title: BC Securities Commission Imposes Penalty on Former Insider of JIVA Technologies Inc.
items.summary: The British Columbia Securities Commission (BCSC) has fined a former reporting insider of JIVA Technologies Inc. $60,000 for failing to file timely reports regarding his securities trading activity.
items.content: The Executive Director of the BC Securities Commission (BCSC) issued a $60,000 administrative penalty against Sean Elan Dollinger, a former reporting insider of JIVA Technologies Inc. (formerly PlantX Life Inc.). The penalty stems from Dollinger's failure to report 258 transactions involving 18.6 million shares, valued at approximately $12.2 million, which occurred between 2020 and 2022. The BCSC determined that these omissions violated National Instrument 55-104 regarding insider reporting requirements and National Instrument 62-104 concerning early warning and issuer bid reporting. The lapses were only identified after BCSC staff contacted the individual in October 2024.

items.title: Cloudastructure Enhances AI-Powered Remote Guarding Platform with Automated Threat Deterrence and Advanced Reporting
items.summary: Cloudastructure, Inc. announced new platform enhancements, including AI-triggered on-site lights and strobes for physical deterrence and an improved customer portal for tracking security interventions and savings.
items.content: Cloudastructure, Inc. has introduced several updates to its cloud-native AI surveillance and remote guarding platform. The enhancements include the integration of AI-triggered on-site lights and strobes, which provide an immediate physical deterrence layer when potential threats are detected. Additionally, the company launched an improved customer portal that offers users greater visibility into security interventions and estimated financial savings, alongside a redesigned user interface. According to the company, these features are designed to extend the platform's utility beyond threat detection, helping customers achieve proactive security outcomes and demonstrating the value of their investment. Cloudastructure also noted that it is utilizing AI-assisted software development to accelerate the delivery of new product capabilities.

This action is part of a broader series of delisting announcements by the exchange regarding various companies that have failed to maintain trading activity.

items.title: Generation Uranium Appoints Director, Updates Activities and Grants Stock Options
items.summary: Generation Uranium Inc. has appointed Monty Sutton as a Director and granted 2.5 million incentive stock options to officers, directors, employees, and consultants.
items.content: Generation Uranium Inc. announced that Monty Sutton, who currently serves as the company's Chief Financial Officer, has been appointed as a Director effective November 23, 2026. Mr. Sutton brings over 35 years of experience in public markets, corporate governance, and accounting. Additionally, the company granted 2.5 million incentive stock options to various officers, directors, employees, and consultants at an exercise price of $0.05, expiring on November 23, 2029. The company also provided an update on its Yath Project in Nunavut, noting the completion of a 21-day field program in July 2026 that integrated field mapping with airborne survey data to identify new uranium anomalies.

items.title: Sleep Number Appoints Two New Independent Directors
items.summary: Sleep Number Corporation has expanded its board of directors with the appointment of Stephen Macadam and Hilary Schneider as independent directors.
items.content: Sleep Number Corporation announced the appointment of Stephen Macadam and Hilary Schneider to its board of directors, effective immediately. Both individuals join the board as independent directors, bringing additional expertise to the company's governance structure. This board expansion is part of the company's ongoing efforts to strengthen its leadership and strategic oversight. The appointments were formally disclosed on November 24, 2026.

items.title: TruGolf Appoints Strategic Advisors and Confirms Board Leadership
items.summary: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of three new strategic advisors and confirmed that David Hackett has succeeded Brenner Adams as Chairman of the Board.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, TruGolf Holdings, Inc. announced that Richard Dolan, Kevin Dent, and Roger Premo have joined the company and its subsidiary, Polymath Research Inc., as strategic advisors. These advisors will focus on issuer, partner, and institutional relationships, with specific mandates covering real-world asset origination, technology and gaming partnerships, and corporate strategy in AI and tokenized financial infrastructure. Additionally, the company confirmed that David Hackett, who joined the board following the October 2026 acquisition of Polymath, has succeeded Brenner Adams as Chairman. Mr. Adams will continue to serve as a director and as the company's Interim Chief Executive Officer.

items.title: Mobix Labs Amends Senior Secured Convertible Notes and Extends Maturity Dates
items.summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. has amended its $1.20 million and $2.80 million senior secured convertible notes and extended their maturity dates to December 14, 2026.
items.content: Mobix Labs, Inc. filed an SEC disclosure regarding the amendment of its senior secured convertible notes, specifically those valued at $1.20 million and $2.80 million. As part of this agreement, the company extended the maturity dates for these notes to December 14, 2026. Additionally, the company is obligated to pay $262,000 in accrued interest by the new maturity date. This action represents a modification to the company's existing debt obligations.

items.title: Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. Completes $4 Million Private Placement and Receives TSX Venture Exchange Approval
items.summary: Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. has closed a fully-subscribed non-brokered private placement raising $4 million and received final TSX Venture Exchange approval for its Fenton option agreement.
items.content: Pacific Imperial Mines Inc. announced the completion of a fully-subscribed non-brokered private placement of flow-through and non-flow-through units, raising aggregate gross proceeds of $4 million. The company intends to use these funds for mining exploration expenditures and general working capital, with flow-through proceeds specifically allocated to qualifying Canadian exploration expenses. Additionally, the company received final approval from the TSX Venture Exchange regarding its option agreement with Hudbay Minerals Inc. for the Fenton property, originally dated January 26, 2026. items.title: Edible Garden Completes Phase 1 of Strategic Beverage Collaboration with Square Roots
items.summary: Edible Garden AG Incorporated announced the successful completion of the first phase of its partnership with Square Roots to develop functional, ready-to-drink greens beverages.
items.content: Edible Garden has successfully completed Phase 1 of its strategic collaboration with Square Roots, aimed at developing clean-label, nutrient-dense, ready-to-drink (RTD) greens beverages for the functional and sports nutrition markets. During this phase, the companies established nutritional objectives, evaluated greenhouse and vertical farming technologies, and identified key crop ingredients. The collaboration also involved early engagement with retail buyers across e-commerce, club, and grocery channels to align the product concept with market trends. The companies, which first announced the partnership in August 2026, are now targeting a product launch at the Natural Products Expo West 2027. This initiative represents a continued effort by Edible Garden to expand its Farm-to-Formula strategy into higher-value functional nutrition products.

items.title: SHARC Energy Secures Purchase Order for Back-Flush Only (BFO) System
items.summary: SHARC International Systems Inc. has received a purchase order for its Back-Flush Only (BFO) system, marking the commercial launch of the new product.
items.content: SHARC International Systems Inc., also known as SHARC Energy, has officially launched its Back-Flush Only (BFO) system following the receipt of a purchase order. This new product platform expands the company's existing wastewater energy transfer technology portfolio. The commercial launch represents a milestone in the company's strategy to deploy its thermal energy capture solutions for commercial, residential, and industrial applications.

items.content: Golden Rapture Mining Corporation announced the closing of the first tranche of its previously announced $700,000 non-brokered private placement on November 23, 2026. The company raised gross proceeds of $130,890 through the issuance of 1,663,000 flow-through units at $0.03 and 3,240,000 non-flow-through units at $0.025. Each unit includes a 36-month warrant exercisable at $0.05. Proceeds from the flow-through units are designated for eligible exploration expenses at the company's northwestern Ontario projects, while non-flow-through funds will support general and administrative costs. Ventum Financial acted as a finder for the transaction, receiving a cash fee and warrants.

items.content: SeaStar Medical Holding Corporation announced two separate capital-raising initiatives through SEC filings. The company filed for a mixed shelf offering of up to $100 million in securities and a separate at-the-market offering for $7.45 million of its common stock. These filings provide the company with the flexibility to raise capital to support its ongoing operations and the development of its extracorporeal therapies. The actions represent a significant step in the company's financial planning and capital allocation strategy.

items.summary: Beyond Minerals Inc. disclosed details regarding its recent offering, including finder fees and broker warrants, and announced the grant of 1,050,000 restricted share units (RSUs) to directors, officers, and consultants.
items.content: Beyond Minerals Inc. provided an update on its recent offering, noting that it paid eligible third-party finders a cash commission of $14,731.02 and issued 409,195 non-transferable broker warrants. Each broker warrant is exercisable for one common share at $0.036 per share for 24 months. The company intends to use the net proceeds for general working capital, exploration activities, and expenditures on its Owl Creek project. Additionally, the company granted 1,050,000 restricted share units (RSUs) to certain directors, officers, and consultants. These RSUs are scheduled to vest in four equal tranches of 25% on February 24, 2027, May 24, 2027, and August 24, 2027.

items.title: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. Completes Debt Settlement
items.summary: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. has finalized the settlement of $378,000 in outstanding debt by issuing 2,519,999 common shares to arm's length creditors.
items.content: Gold'n Futures Mineral Corp. announced the completion of a debt settlement totaling $378,000, which was previously owed to seven arm's length creditors for legal fees and other services. The company issued 2,519,999 common shares at a deemed price of $0.15 per share to satisfy these obligations. Management stated that the settlement was executed to preserve the company's cash for working capital purposes. No insiders participated in the transaction, which was completed in accordance with Canadian Securities Exchange policies. The newly issued shares are subject to a statutory hold period that expires on March 25, 2027.

items.title: Simply Solventless Announces Court Approval of Extension of Stay of CCAA Proceedings
items.summary: The Court of King's Bench of Alberta has granted an order extending the stay of proceedings for Simply Solventless Concentrates Ltd. and its subsidiaries under the Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act.
items.content: Simply Solventless Concentrates Ltd. announced that the Court of King's Bench of Alberta has approved an extension of the stay of proceedings under the Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act (CCAA). The stay, which was previously set to expire on November 30, 2026, has been extended to February 28, 2027. This extension is part of the company's ongoing restructuring efforts. The company remains under the protection of the CCAA as it works through its financial reorganization.

items.title: Niki BioSolutions Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Niki BioSolutions, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenue of $2,015 and a net loss of approximately $2.78 million.
items.content: Niki BioSolutions reported revenue of $2,015 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to no revenue in the same period of 2025, driven by APOE diagnostic laboratory testing services performed by its subsidiary, DiamiR Biosciences. The company recorded a net loss of $2,777,566 for the quarter, an increase from the $1,055,775 loss reported in the prior-year period, primarily attributed to higher general and administrative expenses, including warrant fees and share-based compensation. Operational highlights included the completion of the merger with DiamiR Biosciences on July 20, 2026, the appointment of Tom Freeburg as Chief Financial Officer effective September 1, 2026, and the receipt of expanded Clinical Laboratory Evaluation Program (CLEP) approval for its APOE genotyping test. Management stated its priority is to expand revenue-generating pharma services while advancing the CogniMIR blood test for Alzheimer's risk assessment toward clinical validation in 2027.

items.title: Athena Gold Completes SkyTEM Survey on Forester Project and Updates Laird Lake Progress
items.summary: Athena Gold Corporation has completed a helicopter-borne geophysical survey over its Forester project in Ontario and provided an update on upcoming drilling at its flagship Laird Lake project.
items.content: The company completed approximately 1,779 line-kilometres of time-domain electromagnetic (TDEM) and magnetic surveying over its 100%-owned Forester project, covering 15,000 hectares. This survey provides the first modern, high-resolution airborne geophysical dataset for the property, which has tripled in size since February 2026. Additionally, Athena announced that follow-up drilling at the Scooby Zone of its flagship Laird Lake project is scheduled to commence before the end of the year. The initial phase of the drill campaign will consist of at least 2,000 metres aimed at defining the discovery.

items.title: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. Acquires Hardin County Fluorspar Properties
items.summary: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. has acquired a 1,700-acre package of mineral rights in the Illinois-Kentucky Fluorspar District for US$45,629.
items.content: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. announced the acquisition of 1,700 acres of mineral rights, known as the Hardin County Properties, located in the historic Cave-in-Rock and Rosiclare fluorspar mining district in Illinois. The properties were purchased from an arm's-length third party for a total cash consideration of US$45,629. This acquisition increases the company's total mineral rights holdings in the Illinois-Kentucky Fluorspar District to over 19,550 acres. The company stated that the new properties are situated near the Hicks Dome rare-earth fluorspar deposit and several historic stratiform fluorspar deposits. No securities were issued and no finder's fees were paid in connection with the transaction.

items.title: Crossroads Gold Secures Five-Year Exploration Licence for Club Terrace Project in Victoria, Australia
items.summary: Crossroads Gold Corp. has been granted a five-year exploration licence for the Club Terrace Project in Victoria, Australia, covering a 34 km corridor along the Bemm and Club Terrace faults.
items.content: Crossroads Gold Corp. announced that Resources Victoria has granted Exploration Licence (EL) 008761 to its wholly owned subsidiary, Rox-Ex Pty Ltd. The licence is for a five-year term ending November 19, 2031, and covers 126 km² along the Bemm and Club Terrace faults in East Gippsland, Victoria. The area includes four recognised goldfields and has seen no previous gold exploration drilling. The company plans to integrate historical mine plans with LiDAR mapping and geochemical sampling to identify targets for future drilling.

items.title: Earthwise Minerals Applies to Expand Iron Range Project
items.summary: Earthwise Minerals Corp. has submitted applications for 4,827 hectares of additional mineral tenure northeast of its Iron Range Project in British Columbia.
items.content: Earthwise Minerals Corp. announced the submission of applications for 4,827 hectares of new mineral tenure located northeast of its Iron Range Project in southeastern British Columbia. The expansion follows a reinterpretation of the Talon Zone and a review of historical exploration data, which identified gold anomalies extending approximately 11 kilometers beyond the current property boundary. The company aims to secure the tenure to support potential exploration activities, including geological mapping and sampling, during the summer of 2027. These applications are currently pending and are subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: Onfolio Holdings Announces Nasdaq Stay of Delisting Action
items.summary: Onfolio Holdings Inc. announced that Nasdaq has stayed its previously disclosed delisting action pending a final decision by the Nasdaq Hearings Panel.
items.content: On November 23, 2026, Onfolio Holdings Inc. received confirmation from Nasdaq that the delisting action previously announced on November 13, 2026, has been stayed. This stay remains in effect pending a final written decision by the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, meaning the company's common stock and warrants will continue to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbols ONFO and ONFOW. The company had previously requested a hearing to appeal the Staff determination, which cited concerns regarding minimum bid price and stockholders' equity requirements. The hearing is currently scheduled for January 5, 2027. The company noted that the stay does not constitute a determination that it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements.

items.title: Avrupa Minerals to Attend Resourcing Tomorrow Conference
items.summary: Avrupa Minerals Ltd. announced it will attend the Resourcing Tomorrow Conference in London from December 1-3, 2026, where management will meet with investors and potential joint-venture partners.
items.content: Avrupa Minerals Ltd. (TSXV: AVU) announced its participation in the upcoming Resourcing Tomorrow Conference, scheduled for December 1-3, 2026, in London. President and CEO Paul W. Kuhn will represent the company to engage with shareholders and potential investors. Additionally, Kuhn plans to hold meetings with prospective joint-venture partners regarding the company's exploration portfolio, which includes nine copper-zinc projects in Finland's Pyhäsalmi Mining District and a copper-zinc massive sulfide project in the Portuguese Pyrite Belt. The company continues to advance its projects through a hybrid prospect generator business model.

items.title: Cizzle Brands Launches Exclusive 'Yukon Yellow' Flavor at 7-Eleven Canada
items.summary: Cizzle Brands has expanded its retail footprint by launching its CWENCH Hydration line at 7-Eleven Canada, featuring an exclusive new flavor developed with Gavin McKenna and Coach Chippy.
items.content: Cizzle Brands Corporation has officially rolled out its CWENCH Hydration beverage line across 7-Eleven Canada locations. The launch is anchored by a new, retailer-exclusive flavor called "Yukon Yellow," which was developed in collaboration with Toronto Maple Leafs forward Gavin McKenna and hockey content creator Coach Chippy. This expansion marks the company's largest single convenience retail presence to date, with participating stores stocking the new flavor alongside core offerings like Blue Raspberry, Rainbow Swirl, and Cherry Lime. The beverages are produced in-house at the company's own manufacturing facility in Aurora, Ontario.

items.title: Envoy Technologies Deploys Electric Vehicle Car-Sharing Service at Central Terrace
items.summary: Envoy Technologies, a subsidiary of CID HoldCo, Inc. (Dot Ai), has launched its electric vehicle car-sharing service at the Central Terrace affordable housing community in Oxnard, California.
items.content: Envoy Technologies, a wholly owned subsidiary of CID HoldCo, Inc. (doing business as Dot Ai), announced the deployment of its electric vehicle car-sharing service at Central Terrace, an 87-unit affordable and supportive housing community in Oxnard. The service allows residents and guests to reserve electric vehicles by the hour or day through the Envoy app. Envoy manages the insurance, maintenance, and daily operations of the fleet, providing residents with access to transportation without the costs of individual vehicle ownership. The initiative is intended to provide property owners with an additional amenity while expanding mobility options for residents.

items.title: Aldeyra Therapeutics Requests FDA Transfer of ADX-2191 Review and Withdraws Special Protocol Assessment
items.summary: Aldeyra Therapeutics has requested that the FDA transfer the review of its ADX-2191 investigational new drug application for primary vitreoretinal lymphoma (PVRL) to the Division of Hematologic Malignancies 2 and has withdrawn its Special Protocol Assessment (SPA) for the program.
items.content: Aldeyra Therapeutics has formally requested that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) transfer the regulatory review of its ADX-2191 candidate for primary vitreoretinal lymphoma (PVRL) to the Division of Hematologic Malignancies 2. In conjunction with this request, the company has withdrawn its previously submitted Special Protocol Assessment (SPA) for ADX-2191 in the treatment of PVRL. While the jurisdictional transfer request remains pending with the agency, the company has indicated that it does not expect to initiate the SPA process for the program at this time.

items.title: CanAsia Energy Corp. Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial and Operating Results
items.summary: CanAsia Energy Corp. released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting the recent sale of its subsidiary, Andora Energy Corporation, and upcoming international expansion in Thailand.
items.content: CanAsia Energy Corp. reported its consolidated financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. A key development noted in the report is the completion of the sale of its subsidiary, Andora Energy Corporation, to Logan Oil Corp. on October 30, 2026, for which CanAsia received $29.4 million in cash proceeds. The company is also entitled to potential contingent consideration of $10 million upon the achievement of first oil sales from the Sawn Lake project, along with up to $15 million under a conditional payment agreement. Additionally, the company announced that the signing of the L8/66 petroleum concession in onshore Thailand is scheduled for November 30, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, Andora's assets and liabilities were classified as held for sale and presented as discontinued operations.

items.title: Zentek's Albany Graphite Anode Retains Approximately 98% Capacity After 1,000 Charge-Discharge Cycles
items.summary: Zentek Ltd. reported that its Albany graphite anode material retained approximately 98% of its capacity after 1,000 charge-discharge cycles in lithium-ion battery tests conducted at the University of Toronto.
items.content: Zentek Ltd. announced test results for its 100% owned Albany graphite, demonstrating high performance in lithium-ion battery applications. In tests conducted at the University of Toronto, a lab-fabricated pouch cell using an anode made from the company's graphite retained approximately 98% of its capacity after 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles. For comparison, a control cell using a commercially available graphite anode material for laboratory research retained less than 25% of its initial capacity under the same testing protocol. The company highlighted the potential of this material for use in lightweight battery formats, such as those required for defense equipment like drones.

items.title: Canadian Goldfields Discovery Corp. Increases Private Placement Financing to $6 Million
items.summary: Canadian Goldfields Discovery Corp. has upsized its previously announced non-brokered private placement from $4 million to $6 million.
items.content: Canadian Goldfields Discovery Corp. announced an increase in its non-brokered private placement financing from $4 million to $6 million. The offering now includes 10,714,286 hard dollar units at $0.14 per unit for $1.5 million in gross proceeds and up to 29,032,258 flow-through common shares at $0.155 per share for $4.5 million in gross proceeds. Each hard dollar unit consists of one common share and one-half of a warrant exercisable at $0.20 for three years. The company intends to use the net proceeds from the flow-through shares for eligible exploration expenses at its Miminiska Property, while hard dollar proceeds will support working capital and general corporate purposes.

items.title: PlasCred Circular Innovations Inc. Appoints Alan Withey as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: PlasCred Circular Innovations Inc. has appointed Alan Withey, a finance executive with over 30 years of experience in the energy industry, as its new Chief Financial Officer.
items.content: PlasCred Circular Innovations Inc. announced the appointment of Alan Withey as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective November 24, 2026. Mr. Withey brings over 30 years of experience in finance and the energy sector, having previously served as Executive Vice President and CFO of GLJ Ltd. and held senior roles at companies including Trident Exploration Corp. and Freehold Royalties Ltd. The company noted that his expertise in strategic management, budgeting, and risk management will support PlasCred as it continues to develop its advanced plastic recycling facility in Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta. Brian Hearst, the company's former CFO, was thanked for his service since 2022.

items.title: Metalsource Mining Inc. Issues Correction Notice
items.summary: Metalsource Mining Inc. issued a correction notice regarding its news release disseminated on November 24, 2026.
items.content: Metalsource Mining Inc. released a formal correction notice on November 25, 2026, pertaining to a news release previously issued by the company on November 24, 2026. The notice serves to rectify information contained in the earlier announcement regarding the company's exploration activities.

items.title: Metalsource Mining Inc. Reports Assay Results from Silver Hill Drill Program
items.summary: Metalsource Mining Inc. announced new assay results from its ongoing drill program at the Silver Hill project, highlighting significant polymetallic mineralization.
items.content: Metalsource Mining Inc. reported assay results from its Silver Hill drill program, specifically from drill hole SH26-27. The results indicate significant polymetallic mineralization, including an interval of 17.28 meters grading 32 grams per metric ton silver equivalent (AgEq), with a high-grade sub-interval of 0.67 meters grading 1,192 g/t AgEq. The findings demonstrate the re-emergence of high-grade gold mineralization in the southern portion of the system. Management noted that these results suggest the mineralized system may extend beyond its previously recognized footprint, opening new target areas for future exploration drilling.

items.title: BuildDirect Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Announces Acquisition Agreement
items.summary: BuildDirect.com Technologies Inc. reported a 13.2% year-over-year revenue increase to $20.45 million for Q3 2026 and announced a definitive agreement to acquire a U.S. Midwest-based flooring business.
items.content: BuildDirect.com Technologies Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $20.45 million, a 13.2% increase compared to $18.07 million in the same period last year. Gross profit rose 15.3% to $8.11 million, with gross margins improving to 39.7% from 38.9%. The company also reported an Adjusted EBITDA of $0.60 million, up 52.2% from $0.39 million in the prior year, and generated positive operating cash flow of $1.11 million. Additionally, the company disclosed that it has signed a definitive asset purchase agreement to acquire substantially all operating assets of a carpet and flooring wholesale, retail, and distribution business located in the U.S. Midwest. Pro Centers accounted for 78% of the company's consolidated revenue during the quarter.

items.title: Jaguar Uranium Announces Maiden Mineral Resource Estimate at the Berlin Polymetallic Project in Colombia
items.summary: Jaguar Uranium Corp. has released its first independent Mineral Resource Estimate for the initial 2.9 km of the 10.5 km mineralized trend at its flagship Berlin Project.
items.content: The maiden Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) for the Berlin Uranium-Polymetallic Project reports 1.2 million pounds of indicated resources at 561 ppm U3O8 and 14.1 million pounds of inferred resources at 562 ppm U3O8. The deposit also contains critical minerals including rare earth oxides, vanadium, nickel, zinc, molybdenum, and phosphate. The estimate covers the initial 2.9 km of a 10.5 km trend, with the company noting significant potential for expansion along the remaining strike length. The MRE was prepared in accordance with Regulation S-K 1300 and NI 43-101 standards. Jaguar plans to file a supporting technical report on SEDAR+ and with the SEC within 45 days.

items.title: RenovoRx Files $50 Million Shelf Registration
items.summary: RenovoRx, Inc. has filed a shelf registration statement for the potential offering of up to $50 million in securities.
items.content: RenovoRx, Inc. has filed a shelf registration statement with the SEC, allowing for the potential future sale of up to $50 million in securities. This filing provides the company with flexibility to raise capital through various methods, such as common stock, preferred stock, or debt, depending on market conditions and corporate needs. The registration is a standard financial procedure for public companies to maintain access to capital markets.

items.title: MustGrow Biologics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: MustGrow Biologics Corp. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $695,096 from its TerraSante product, compared to no revenue in the same period of 2025.
items.content: MustGrow Biologics Corp. (TSXV: MGRO) announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, highlighting a significant increase in commercial activity for its TerraSante product. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $695,096, exceeding the total revenue of $599,000 recorded for the full year 2025. For the nine-month period, TerraSante revenue reached $868,067, representing a 177% year-over-year increase. Management noted that sales were constrained by product availability as manufacturing partners worked to scale production to meet demand. The company also reported a net loss from continuing operations of $1.5 million for the quarter, down from $2.1 million in the prior-year period, and ended the quarter with $3.1 million in cash and equivalents.

items.title: NextBoat Inc. Insiders Report Recent Stock Purchases
items.summary: Multiple company insiders, including directors and a vice president, have reported recent open-market purchases of NextBoat Inc. common stock.
items.content: NextBoat Inc. (NXB) insiders have disclosed recent stock acquisitions in filings submitted on November 24, 2026. Director Brian John reported the purchase of 3,615 shares at a price of $1.50 per share, totaling approximately $5,423. Additionally, Vice President and Director Andrew James Simmons reported the purchase of 4,000 shares at $1.27 per share, totaling approximately $5,080. These transactions were formally reported to the SEC via Form 4 filings.

items.title: Silver Viper Minerals Announces Surface Exploration Results at Coneto Project
items.summary: Silver Viper Minerals Corp. reported that its inaugural surface work program at the Coneto Project in Durango, Mexico, successfully extended the historic La Palma vein by 1,250 meters.
items.content: Silver Viper Minerals Corp. announced that initial surface mapping and sampling at its Coneto Project has identified a 1,250-meter southeast extension of the historic La Palma vein, connecting it with the Promontorio vein system. The combined vein system now spans approximately 4.8 kilometers. Additionally, the company identified a 550-meter surface extension south of the historical resource area and documented 35 veins through structural mapping. These findings, supported by drone topographic surveys and LiDAR scans of the La Fortuna underground workings, will inform a drill program scheduled for early next year. The company also confirmed it has filed a National Instrument 43-101 compliant technical report for the project.

items.title: Lion One Metals Reports High-Grade Gold Results from Tuvatu Zone 500
items.summary: Lion One Metals Limited announced significant new high-grade gold drill results from the first underground drill hole targeting Zone 500 at its Tuvatu Alkaline Gold Project in Fiji.
items.content: Lion One Metals Limited has reported high-grade gold assay results from drillhole TGC-0709, the first underground drill hole to target Zone 500 at its 100%-owned Tuvatu Alkaline Gold Project in Fiji. The company disclosed that the drill hole intersected 44.39 g/t Au over 2.0 meters. These results represent a new development in the company's ongoing exploration and production activities at the Tuvatu site.

items.title: Form 8.3 - The Vanguard Group, Inc.: Tate & Lyle plc

items.title: Laurion Announces Proposed Private Placement of Flow-Through Units
items.summary: Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc. has announced a proposed non-brokered private placement to raise up to $1.5 million in gross proceeds to fund exploration at its Ishkoday Project.
items.content: Laurion Mineral Exploration Inc. announced a proposed non-brokered flow-through private placement aiming to raise up to approximately $1.5 million. The offering consists of up to 14,285,714 flow-through units priced at $0.105 per unit. Each unit includes one common share issued as a flow-through share and one-half of one common share purchase warrant. Each whole warrant allows the holder to acquire one non-flow-through common share at a price of $0.18 for a period of 24 months. The company intends to use the gross proceeds to fund eligible exploration expenses at its 100%-owned Ishkoday Gold and Polymetallic Project in Northern Ontario. The completion of the financing remains subject to regulatory approvals, including from the TSX Venture Exchange.

items.title: Local Bounti Completes Acquisition of Revol Greens' Certified-Organic Facilities
items.summary: Local Bounti Corporation has finalized the purchase of two certified-organic controlled environment agriculture facilities from Revol Greens, significantly expanding its production capacity.
items.content: Local Bounti Corporation announced the completion of its acquisition of two certified-organic controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities located in Temple, Texas, and Medford, Minnesota, along with the Revol brand. This transaction adds 30 acres of certified-organic production to the company's portfolio and increases its total growing footprint by approximately 70%. The acquisition is intended to broaden Local Bounti's product assortment with new organic offerings for its retail customers. The deal was supported by existing strategic investor FoodVentures, a member of the DENSO Group, and other investors.

items.title: Franklin Access Launches SG1000 and SG2000 5G Routers
items.summary: Franklin Wireless Corp. (operating as Franklin Access) has expanded its 5G networking portfolio with the introduction of the SG1000 and SG2000 Wireless WAN routers.
items.content: Franklin Access, the DBA of Franklin Wireless Corp., announced the launch of the SG1000 and SG2000, two new 5G Wireless WAN routers designed for enterprise and industrial applications. The SG1000 is aimed at commercial markets such as retail, hospitality, and branch offices, featuring a compact design, dual 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports, and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities. The SG2000 is built for rugged industrial environments, including utilities and manufacturing, with a reinforced aluminum enclosure, four 2.5Gbps Ethernet ports, and PoE input. Both devices support automated cellular failover and IP passthrough to facilitate integration into existing infrastructure. The company stated that this dual-product launch is intended to broaden its addressable market across both distributed commercial enterprises and specialized industrial sectors.

items.title: Next Hydrogen Solutions Inc. Announces Strategic Collaboration with H2 Manufacturing LLC
items.summary: Next Hydrogen Solutions Inc. and H2 Manufacturing LLC have entered into a strategic partnership to develop and support distributed hydrogen production solutions across North America.
items.content: Next Hydrogen Solutions Inc. and Tulsa-based H2 Manufacturing LLC have announced a strategic collaboration to develop, install, and support distributed hydrogen production solutions for the North American market. The partnership combines Next Hydrogen's advanced alkaline electrolyzer technology with H2 Manufacturing's expertise in hydrogen compression, storage, and fueling station infrastructure. This collaboration aims to provide integrated solutions for customers seeking to decarbonize their operations. The companies intend to leverage their respective technical capabilities to enhance the deployment of hydrogen production systems.

items.title: Edge Total Intelligence Launches TAMA™ Platform for Process Modelling and Automation
items.summary: Edge Total Intelligence Inc. has announced the general availability of TAMA™ (Technical Activity Modelling & Automation), a platform designed to help complex and regulated organizations manage process design, governance, and execution.
items.content: Edge Total Intelligence Inc. (edgeTI) has officially launched TAMA™, a new platform aimed at enabling organizations to convert approved process models into assigned workflows. The platform features integrated version control, approval tracking, and execution history to support process-intensive and regulated industries. By connecting process design to actual execution, TAMA provides a structured environment for managing roles, rules, forms, and documentation. This release expands the company's existing portfolio, joining other solutions such as ALFI, LUSI, and BOSS, as well as the EDMT digital twin suite. The product was developed by generalizing field-proven models and incorporating AI-assisted authoring and governance layers.

items.title: Spectral AI Highlights Participation at 46th ICMM World Congress of Military Medicine
items.summary: Spectral AI showcased its FDA-cleared DeepView AI System at the 46th ICMM World Congress of Military Medicine in Abu Dhabi, emphasizing its commercial strategy and upcoming sales targets.
items.content: Spectral AI, Inc. reported its participation in the 46th ICMM World Congress of Military Medicine, held in Abu Dhabi from November 9–13, 2026. The company utilized the event to engage with global military medical leaders and healthcare professionals as part of its ongoing commercial strategy. During the congress, the company's DeepView AI System for burn indication was featured, including a presentation by Dr. Jeffrey Carter regarding the training and validation of the device. Management reiterated that the company expects to achieve its first sales of the DeepView AI System by the end of 2026.

items.title: Bonterra Resources Announces Exercise of Earn-In Right by Gold Fields for Phoenix Joint Venture
items.summary: Bonterra Resources Inc. announced that Gold Fields Limited, through its subsidiary Windfall Mining Group Inc., has exercised its earn-in right to acquire a 70% interest in the Phoenix Joint Venture.
items.content: Bonterra Resources Inc. confirmed that Gold Fields Limited has exercised its right to earn a 70% interest in the Phoenix Joint Venture, which covers the Urban-Barry properties in Quebec. This exercise follows Gold Fields' completion of a C$30 million funding commitment over a three-year period, as stipulated in an agreement originally signed in 2024 involving Bonterra, Osisko Mining, and UB Phoenix. Following this transaction, Bonterra retains a 30% interest in the Urban-Barry properties. The move marks a significant shift in the ownership structure of these exploration assets.

items.title: CMX Gold & Silver Corp. Completes Geophysical Surveys and Updates Financing
items.summary: CMX Gold & Silver Corp. has completed 3D Induced Polarization and Magnetotelluric geophysical surveys at its Clayton Silver Project in Idaho and reported progress on its private placement and warrant exercises.
items.content: CMX Gold & Silver Corp. announced the completion of extensive 3D Induced Polarization (3DIP) and Magnetotelluric (MT) geophysical surveys conducted by DIAS Geophysical at its Clayton Silver Project in Idaho. The company expects to receive and begin interpreting the comprehensive results in December 2026, which will help identify sub-surface drill targets for a planned diamond drilling program in early 2027. Additionally, the company reported closing a second tranche of $220,000 in its non-brokered private placement, bringing the total raised in the first two tranches to $1,130,000. Furthermore, on November 19, 2026, the company received $222,000 from the exercise of 2,220,000 warrants by directors, insiders, and shareholders. Proceeds from these capital activities are earmarked for work programs at the Clayton Silver Project and general working capital.

items.title: Helium Evolution Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Provides Development Update
items.summary: Helium Evolution Incorporated announced its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting a strong cash position and progress on its Saskatchewan exploration projects.
items.content: Helium Evolution reported its financial and operating results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The company ended the quarter with $24.9 million in cash and cash equivalents and $25.1 million in working capital, following a $25 million gross private placement completed in August. Development updates include the advancement of permitting for up to 10 wells at the Grasslands project, with drilling anticipated as early as January 2027. Additionally, the company noted that its common shares became Depository Trust Company (DTC) eligible in August, facilitating electronic clearing and settlement in the U.S. The company continues to focus on its helium assets in southern Saskatchewan, leveraging its Soda Lake infrastructure for potential future production.

items.title: Westward Gold Reports Assay Results from SSD Target at Toiyabe Hills Property
items.summary: Westward Gold Inc. announced assay results for the first reverse-circulation drill hole, T2603, at the SSD Target within its Toiyabe Hills Property in Nevada.
items.content: The company reported that hole T2603 intersected four significant gold zones, including a 7.6-metre interval grading 1.97 g Au/t, with individual samples reaching up to 5.96 g Au/t. The mineralization is hosted in decalcified and carbonaceous silty limestone of the Wenban Formation. Due to drilling complications, the hole did not fully test the intended targets, and subsequent holes at the SSD Target have been cased for core tail completions in 2027. Drilling remains ongoing at the El Segundo Target, with the 2026 campaign expected to conclude in early December.

items.title: Trading Halted in Honey Badger Silver Inc. Shares
items.summary: The Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) implemented a temporary trading halt on Honey Badger Silver Inc. shares pending news.
items.content: The Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) halted trading in Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) on November 24, 2026, at 12:58:50 pm ET. The halt was issued pending news, a standard procedure used by the regulator to maintain a fair and orderly market. The suspension applied to all issues of the company.

items.title: Honey Badger Silver Reports High-Grade Drill Results at Sunrise Lake Project
items.summary: Honey Badger Silver announced high-grade silver-equivalent drill intercepts from its Sunrise Lake project and plans for an updated mineral resource estimate.
items.content: Honey Badger Silver reported high-grade silver-equivalent drill intercepts from three holes at its Sunrise Lake project. The company intends to use these 2026 results, alongside its historical database, to support an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate and evaluate a potential 2027 exploration program. Assays for three additional holes are currently pending, with results expected within four to six weeks. Additionally, the company reported receiving a five-year Type A Land Use Permit and a $148,450 grant to support its activities.

items.title: SRX Global Acknowledges Receipt of Schedule 13D Filing
items.summary: SRX Global Inc. acknowledged that stockholders Kevin Egan and Kiewiet Lee filed a Schedule 13D with the SEC regarding their beneficial ownership of the company.
items.content: SRX Global Inc. has formally acknowledged a Schedule 13D filing submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 19, 2026, by stockholders Kevin Egan and Kiewiet Lee. According to the filing, these individuals beneficially own approximately 9.9% of the company's outstanding common stock. The company stated that its Board of Directors and management team will review the matters raised in the filing in consultation with their legal and financial advisors. SRX Global emphasized its commitment to constructive shareholder engagement and maintaining strong corporate governance.

items.title: Vesicor Therapeutics Targets Late 2027 for Initiation of Human Clinical Trials for VES991
items.summary: Vesicor Therapeutics has announced its development strategy for VES991, an oral RNA-based therapeutic for glioblastoma, targeting the start of human clinical trials in late 2027.
items.content: Vesicor Therapeutics is advancing the development of VES991, an investigational, orally administered RNA-based molecular therapeutic designed to treat glioblastoma. The candidate utilizes the company's proprietary microvesicle delivery platform to deliver p53 mRNA and siRNA for MDM2 suppression, aiming to cross the blood-brain barrier and restore tumor suppression mechanisms. The company has set a target to initiate human clinical trials for the program in late 2027. Management views this as a significant milestone for its delivery platform and its broader oncology strategy, noting that p53 pathway dysfunction is present in approximately 50% of all tumors.

items.title: ZYUS Life Sciences Closes Third Tranche of Private Placement, Grants Options, and Amends Debt
items.summary: ZYUS Life Sciences Corporation completed the third tranche of its non-brokered private placement, raising up to C$3 million, while also announcing stock option grants and amendments to secured loan agreements.
items.content: ZYUS Life Sciences Corporation has completed the third tranche of its non-brokered private placement, issuing up to 6,666,666 units for aggregate gross proceeds of up to C$3,000,000. In conjunction with this financing, the company announced the grant of stock options to eligible participants and the formal amendment of certain existing secured loan agreements. These actions are part of the company's ongoing capital management strategy to support its clinical-stage operations and drug development programs. The company has previously disclosed the closing of earlier tranches of this offering.

items.title: Reko International Group Reports Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Reko International Group Inc. announced its financial results for the three and twelve months ended July 31, 2026, reporting annual sales growth alongside a decline in gross profit and adjusted EBITDA.
items.content: For the fiscal year ended July 31, 2026, Reko International Group reported a 5.2% increase in sales to $44.358 million, while gross profit declined by $0.5 million to $6.719 million. Earnings per share for the fiscal year were $0.51, compared to $0.19 in the prior year, though adjusted earnings per share decreased to $0.32 from $0.39. In the fourth quarter, sales rose 9.8% to $11.835 million, while adjusted EBITDA fell 27.8% to $1.2 million. Management attributed the decline in gross margin to higher labor costs, a lower proportion of earned revenue relative to sales, and additional project-specific costs associated with certain fixed-price contracts.
