items.title: Kutcho Copper Announces Non-Brokered Private Placement
items.summary: Kutcho Copper Corp. has announced a non-brokered private placement to raise up to CAD $1,000,000 through the issuance of units.
items.content: Kutcho Copper Corp. announced a non-brokered private placement to raise gross proceeds of up to CAD $1,000,000. The offering consists of up to 2,857,143 units at a price of $0.35 per unit. The company intends to use the proceeds to advance its copper-zinc-gold-silver project in northern British Columbia. This financing is part of the company's ongoing efforts to support its exploration and development activities.

items.title: Brixton Metals Reports 2026 Drill Results from Thorn Project
items.summary: Brixton Metals Corporation announced 2026 drill results from the Catalyst and Sentinel porphyry targets at its wholly owned Thorn Project in British Columbia.
items.content: Brixton Metals Corporation reported drill results from its 2026 exploration program at the Thorn Project, focusing on the Catalyst and Sentinel porphyry targets. At the Catalyst target, four holes totaling 2,070 meters were drilled to expand the footprint of the copper-gold porphyry system discovered in 2025. Results included hole THN26-391, which returned 258.66 meters of 0.29% CuEq, and hole THN26-395, which returned 330.34 meters of 0.23% CuEq. Additionally, the company completed its first-ever drilling at the Sentinel target, where hole THN26-386 intersected 158.00 meters of 0.25% CuEq, indicating the potential for a new porphyry district in the eastern part of the project.

items.title: The Beachbody Company, Inc. Announces Retirement of Executive Chairman Mark R. Goldston
items.summary: The Beachbody Company, Inc. announced that Mark R. Goldston will retire as Executive Chairman and step down from the Board of Directors, effective November 25, 2026.
items.content: The Beachbody Company, Inc. (BODi) announced that Mark R. Goldston is retiring from his role as Executive Chairman and stepping down from the Board of Directors, effective November 25, 2026. Following his departure, the company's Board of Directors has reinstated Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer Carl Daikeler as Chairman of the Board. Goldston, who joined the company to assist with its financial turnaround and transition to an omnichannel business model, was credited with helping to restructure the company, refinance debt, and achieve 12 consecutive quarters of positive adjusted EBITDA. He also contributed to the development of the company's innovation pipeline, including new nutritional supplements and energy products slated for 2027 and beyond.

items.title: 374Water Clears Second Factory Acceptance Test and Prepares for System Shipment
items.summary: 374Water successfully completed its second factory acceptance test, exceeding its accepted capacity by 59%, and is scheduled to ship its AirSCWO system to the Orange County Sanitation District next week.
items.content: 374Water announced that its AirSCWO technology system has successfully cleared its second factory acceptance test. The system performed at 59% above its accepted capacity during the evaluation. Following this milestone, the company is preparing to ship the unit to the Orange County Sanitation District, with delivery expected to take place next week.

items.title: MIND Technology Announces Fiscal 2027 Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call Schedule
items.summary: MIND Technology, Inc. has scheduled the release of its fiscal 2027 third-quarter financial results for December 8, 2026, followed by a conference call on December 9, 2026.
items.content: MIND Technology, Inc. announced that it will release its financial results for the fiscal 2027 third quarter, which ended October 31, 2026, after the market closes on Tuesday, December 8, 2026. In conjunction with the release, the company has scheduled a live conference call for Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Central Time). The call will be broadcast live over the internet, and a replay will be available for a period following the event.

items.title: Cosa Resources Announces Results of Ambient Noise Tomography Survey at Astro Project
items.summary: Cosa Resources Corp. reported the results of a summer ambient noise tomography (ANT) survey at its Astro uranium project in the Athabasca Basin, which identified significant seismic velocity anomalies.
items.content: Cosa Resources Corp. announced the findings from a summer ambient noise tomography (ANT) survey conducted at the Astro project in the eastern Athabasca Basin. The survey, which was fully funded by project partner Global Uranium Corporation, identified extensive velocity anomalies along the AS-1 conductive corridor. These anomalies may indicate alteration in the lower sandstone, a feature often associated with prospective uranium geological settings in the region. Additionally, the modelled unconformity surface shows up to 250 metres of relief adjacent to these anomalies, suggesting significant structural potential. The project is located approximately 28 kilometres west of the McArthur River uranium mine.

items.title: MBody AI to Participate in StoneX 15th Annual Discovery Conference
items.summary: MBody AI announced that CEO John Fowler will participate in the StoneX 15th Annual Discovery Conference on December 10, 2026.
items.content: MBody AI Ltd. announced that its Chief Executive Officer, John Fowler, is scheduled to participate in the StoneX 15th Annual Discovery Conference. The event, which focuses on connecting institutional investors with emerging growth companies, will take place on December 10, 2026, at the New York Athletic Club in New York City. During the conference, the company plans to discuss the adoption of its Orchestrator platform, which is designed to manage autonomous robot workforces for various industries. Management intends to highlight the platform's role in improving operational efficiency and addressing workforce shortages.

items.title: Hannan Metals Announces Results of Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders
items.summary: Hannan Metals Limited held its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders on November 24, 2026, where shareholders approved all submitted matters.
items.content: Hannan Metals Limited announced the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on November 24, 2026, in Vancouver, BC. Shareholders voted in favor of all matters presented in the Notice of Meeting and Information Circular dated October 20, 2026. Key outcomes included setting the size of the Board of Directors to four members and the election of Michael Hudson, Georgina Carnegie, Nick DeMare, and David Henstridge as directors until the next annual meeting.

items.title: High Arctic Overseas Holdings Corp. Announces Annual General and Special Meeting Results
items.summary: High Arctic Overseas Holdings Corp. reported the results of its annual general and special meeting held on November 23, 2026, where shareholders approved all proposed matters.
items.content: High Arctic Overseas Holdings Corp. (TSXV: HOH) announced the results of its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held on November 23, 2026. Approximately 54.91% of the total issued and outstanding common shares were represented at the meeting. Shareholders approved all matters presented, including the appointment of MNP LLP as the corporation's auditors and the approval of an amended and restated omnibus equity incentive plan. Additionally, shareholders voted to fix the number of directors at three.

items.title: SPC Nickel Corp. Announces High-Grade Assay Results from 2026 Muskox Project Exploration
items.summary: SPC Nickel Corp. reported high-grade copper, nickel, and platinum group metal (PGM) assay results from its 2026 exploration program at the Muskox Project in Nunavut, Canada.
items.content: SPC Nickel Corp. announced assay results from its 2026 exploration program at the 100%-owned Muskox Cu-Ni-PGM Project in Nunavut. The program included a six-day prospecting effort in August, during which 60 samples were collected from the main Muskox Intrusion and the Feeder Dyke. Results confirmed high-grade mineralization, including eight samples from the SKOX South Area that averaged 2.45% Cu, 1.20% Ni, and 4.22 g/t PGM. Additionally, the company identified two new high-grade sulphide occurrences at the Central and North Creek areas. Management noted that the strongest modelled electromagnetic conductors in the SKOX South and East Keel areas align closely with these surface samples, providing refined targets for future drilling.

items.title: BCM Resources Corporation Deploys Second Drill Rig at Thompson Knolls Project
items.summary: BCM Resources Corporation has mobilized a second diamond drill rig to its Thompson Knolls porphyry project in Utah to accelerate exploration at the TK26 drill pad.
items.content: BCM Resources Corporation has announced the arrival and setup of a second TonaTec diamond drill rig at its Thompson Knolls porphyry copper-gold-silver-molybdenum project in Millard County, Utah. The rig is positioned at drill pad TK26, located in the center of a geophysical anomaly, where the company intends to test for the upper part of a quartz monzonite porphyry intrusive. Management anticipates that the fanglomerate thickness at this location will be shallower than in previous northern drilling, potentially revealing a zone of oxidation and secondary enrichment. This deployment is part of the company's ongoing Phase 5 exploration program.

items.title: FatPipe Awarded Statewide Arizona Government Procurement Contract
items.summary: FatPipe, Inc. has been awarded a statewide procurement contract by the Mohave Educational Services Cooperative to provide firewall and cybersecurity solutions to public-sector organizations in Arizona.
items.content: FatPipe, Inc. announced on November 24, 2026, that it secured a statewide procurement contract with the Mohave Educational Services Cooperative. This agreement enables Arizona public-sector entities, including K-12 school districts, colleges, universities, and government agencies, to purchase FatPipe's firewall hardware, software, and cybersecurity services without the need for individual competitive solicitations. The company stated that the contract aims to help these organizations address security threats while navigating budget and staffing constraints. Vikrant Ragula, VP of Corporate Development, noted that the award serves as an opportunity to expand the company's footprint in the public sector by providing integrated network security and reliability.

The filing indicates upcoming corporate governance or shareholder-related actions. No further details regarding the specific proposals or meeting agenda were disclosed in the summary information.

items.title: ALUULA Composites Announces Board of Directors Appointments and Leadership Transition
items.summary: ALUULA Composites Inc. has appointed Gary Smith to its Board of Directors and announced a leadership transition, including the appointment of a new Chair and Vice-Chair.
items.content: ALUULA Composites Inc. announced the appointment of Gary Smith to its Board of Directors, effective November 24, 2026. Mr. Smith brings over 25 years of executive experience in scaling global ingredient brands, having previously served as CEO of The LYCRA Company and Polartec. Concurrently, the company announced that Peter Gustavson will retire from the Board. As part of the leadership transition, current director Christophe Dardel has been named Chair of the Board, and Hannes Blum has been appointed as Vice-Chair. These changes are part of the company's ongoing succession planning to strengthen its global leadership in advanced materials and commercialization.

items.title: Cango Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 30, 2026
items.summary: Cango Inc. announced it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 30, 2026.
items.content: Cango Inc. (NYSE: CANG) has scheduled the release of its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, for Monday, November 30, 2026. Following the release, the company's management will host a conference call to discuss the financial performance. The call is set for 9:00 P.M. Eastern Time on November 30, 2026, which corresponds to 10:00 A.M. Hong Kong Time on December 1, 2026. Investors and interested parties can access the earnings release and a live or archived webcast of the conference call through the company's investor relations website.

items.title: Emerita Resources Announces Date for Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders
items.summary: Emerita Resources Corp. has scheduled its annual general and special meeting of shareholders for March 31, 2027, combining it with a previously requisitioned special meeting.
items.content: Emerita Resources Corp. announced that its Board of Directors has set March 31, 2027, as the date for its annual general and special meeting of shareholders. The company decided to combine this meeting with a previously requisitioned special meeting, which requested the removal and replacement of three directors, to improve efficiency and avoid the costs of holding two separate meetings. The meeting will also address standard annual business, including the presentation of audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026. The record date for the meeting has been established as February 19, 2027.

items.title: NetraMark Holdings Inc. Highlights Fiscal 2026 Accomplishments and Strategic Priorities
items.summary: NetraMark Holdings Inc. reported a year of significant commercial expansion, including record contract bookings and the successful implementation of its NetraAI platform in clinical trial datasets.
items.content: NetraMark Holdings Inc. announced its fiscal year 2026 results, highlighting a substantial increase in contracted business and the commercial adoption of its NetraAI platform for analyzing patient-level responses in clinical trials. The company reported record new contract bookings for 2026 totaling approximately C$3.415 million, representing a 645% increase over its previous annual high. Management emphasized that the company's focus for fiscal 2027 is to build upon this foundation through a repeatable commercialization strategy. Additionally, the company noted its successful uplisting to the Toronto Stock Exchange earlier in 2026, which was accompanied by a C$3.5 million insider-led private placement. NetraMark also reported progress in its commercial activation plans, including collaboration with its primary contract research organization (CRO) to integrate NetraAI into sponsor proposal workflows.

items.title: Ares Strategic Mining Inc. Expands Mineral Claim Portfolio at Spor Mountain Fluorspar Project
items.summary: Ares Strategic Mining Inc. has expanded its mineral claim portfolio at the Spor Mountain Fluorspar Project in Utah to 371 unpatented lode mining claims, an increase of approximately 23% from its previous disclosure.
items.content: Ares Strategic Mining Inc. announced an update and expansion of its mineral claim portfolio at the Spor Mountain Fluorspar Project in Juab County, Utah. The company now holds 371 unpatented lode mining claims, representing a 69-claim increase over the 302 claims reported in its June 2026 annual disclosure. This expansion is part of the company's strategy to strengthen its district-scale exploration platform around the Lost Sheep operation as it prepares an updated technical report for a planned NASDAQ uplist. The company estimates a preliminary mapped footprint of approximately 6,600 acres for the expanded claim inventory. Management stated that the land position is central to its long-term domestic fluorspar platform strategy, providing additional areas for geological review and future development.

items.title: Swiss Financial Regulator Approves UBS Recovery Plan
items.summary: The Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) has approved the updated recovery plan submitted by UBS, noting improvements in the bank's resolution planning and crisis readiness.
items.content: The Swiss financial regulator, FINMA, has officially approved the recovery plan submitted by UBS. The regulator stated that the bank's ability to be resolved in a crisis has improved, confirming that UBS can be recapitalized and restructured under its preferred 'single point of entry' bail-in strategy if necessary. As part of the updated planning, UBS has incorporated additional stabilization measures, adjusted existing ones, and adopted a more conservative approach to modeling potential asset sales. Furthermore, the bank has refined its internal escalation processes and improved its capacity to provide reliable liquidity estimates and valuations for various action options. UBS continues to work on its group-wide resolution planning, including the preparation for potential partial divestments to remove operational and financial obstacles.

items.title: Bouygues Travaux Publics Joint Venture Deploys Electric Haulers at Lower Thames Crossing
items.summary: BMJV, a joint venture involving Bouygues Travaux Publics, has begun operating the world's first electric A40 articulated haulers at the Lower Thames Crossing project site.
items.content: BMJV, a joint venture between Bouygues Travaux Publics and J Murphy & Sons, is utilizing four new electric A40 articulated haulers for the Lower Thames Crossing project in Essex. The machines, delivered by Volvo Construction Equipment, are being charged on-site using hydrogen-powered generators produced from renewable energy sources. The deployment supports the construction of road foundations, structures, and tunnel access for the project. Programme Director Shaun Pidcock noted that the transition to electric machinery demonstrates that heavy-duty construction tasks can be performed cleanly and efficiently.

items.content: Financial analysts have issued updated price targets for The Procter & Gamble Company as of November 25, 2026. BNP Paribas adjusted its price target to $197 from $189, while Morgan Stanley raised its target to $192 from $185. Additionally, BofA Securities maintained its buy rating and raised its price target to $190 from $185, and Citi maintained its buy rating with a $190 price target. items.title: Amplifon Secures €1.2 Billion Credit Facility for GN Hearing Acquisition
items.summary: Amplifon has signed a new €1.2 billion credit facility with a pool of banks to support its acquisition of GN Hearing and refinance existing debt.
items.content: Amplifon S.p.A. has finalized a €1.2 billion credit facility to fund the cash component of its acquisition of GN Hearing, which is expected to close by the end of 2026. The new financing package, which includes a term loan and a revolving credit line, will also be used to fully repay a €350 million guaranteed bond issued in 2020, including accrued interest and premiums. Additionally, the company is undergoing a reorganization of its non-EU subsidiaries, transferring them to Amplifon Partecipazioni I to optimize management and future integration. Analysts have noted the reorganization as a positive step in the company's strategic planning.

The collaboration aims to jointly develop and market a new generation of MicroLED technology for display screens. Samsung Display will provide multi-year development funding, with ams Osram expecting significant annual revenue from the partnership. This investment is intended to strengthen the technological capabilities of both companies in the display sector.

items.title: Volvo Construction Equipment Deploys World's First A40 Electric Haulers at Lower Thames Crossing
items.summary: Volvo Construction Equipment has delivered the first A40 Electric articulated haulers to the BMJV joint venture for use at the Lower Thames Crossing infrastructure project.
items.content: Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE) has delivered the world's first A40 Electric articulated haulers to the BMJV joint venture, which is working on the Lower Thames Crossing project in the UK. The four battery-electric machines are being used to build foundations and structures for the new tunnel under the Thames. These haulers are part of a broader effort to achieve carbon-neutral construction on the site, where diesel has been phased out since 2025. The A40 Electric model, which entered serial production previously, offers zero exhaust emissions and lower noise levels compared to traditional equipment.

items.title: South Korean Government to Support Semiconductor Labor Needs for Samsung and SK Hynix
items.summary: The South Korean government is launching a public-private training program to address the projected labor shortage for major semiconductor projects by Samsung and SK Hynix.

SK Hynix is currently engaged in the construction of the first of four planned fabs at its Icheon semiconductor cluster, alongside other large-scale projects in the Honam region.

items.title: Schneider Electric Expands Manufacturing Capacity in Italy for Data Center Cooling
items.summary: Schneider Electric is doubling its manufacturing capacity for cooling distribution units (CDUs) at its Conselve, Italy facility to meet rising demand for liquid cooling in AI-driven data centers.
items.content: Schneider Electric is significantly expanding its production capabilities at its Conselve, Italy site to address the growing need for liquid cooling solutions in the European data center market. The company plans to double its manufacturing capacity for cooling distribution units (CDUs) by January 2027 and increase chiller production capacity by 50% by the end of 2026. Additionally, a new cooling test laboratory, scheduled for completion in December 2027, will triple the site's existing testing capacity, allowing for the validation of high-capacity cooling systems. This investment builds upon the company's 2025 acquisition of a controlling stake in liquid cooling specialist Motivair, whose products are now integrated into the Schneider Electric portfolio.

items.title: Mediobanca Completes €105 Million Quarzo Mezzanine Note Placement
items.summary: Mediobanca has successfully placed €105 million in mezzanine notes through its Quarzo securitization program, which involves consumer credit receivables originated by Compass.
items.content: Mediobanca has completed the placement of three mezzanine notes totaling €105 million under its Quarzo securitization program, which securitizes consumer credit receivables originated by its subsidiary, Compass. The notes were priced at an average spread of 131 basis points over Euribor 3M, with investor demand averaging 5.1 times the amount offered. International investors accounted for approximately 95% of the orders. This transaction follows a €650 million senior tranche placement completed on 24 September 2026, bringing the total funding raised through Quarzo securitizations in 2026 to over €1.6 billion. The bank expects the transaction to provide a Significant Risk Transfer benefit, resulting in a reduction of Risk Weighted Assets in line with its strategic plan.

items.title: Imaginostics Signs MOU with Siemens Healthineers for Vascular MRI Collaboration
items.summary: Imaginostics, Inc. has entered into a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Siemens Healthineers to explore technical and commercial pathways for its quantitative vascular MRI platform.
items.content: Imaginostics, Inc. and Siemens Healthineers have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to evaluate potential technical and commercial collaborations. The partnership aims to explore the integration of Imaginostics' ImagiView pulse sequence and ImagiSight analysis software with Siemens Healthineers' MAGNETOM MRI systems. Additionally, the companies intend to investigate future prototype developments. Siemens Healthineers is also exploring open interface concepts, such as Open Sequence and Open Recon, to facilitate external development activities related to MRI sequences.

items.title: Hexagon CTO Shares 2027 Industry Predictions on Humanoid Robots and AI
items.summary: Hexagon's CTO Burkhard Boeckem discussed the future of humanoid robots and the necessity of data trust in AI-driven manufacturing for 2027.
items.content: Burkhard Boeckem, CTO at Hexagon, shared his outlook for 2027, predicting that humanoid robots will transition from controlled pilots to performing defined, repetitive, and hazardous tasks in industrial settings. He emphasized that the successful integration of AI in physical environments depends on data quality and trust, warning that even minor inaccuracies in real-world data can lead to significant consequences. Boeckem advocated for the use of precise measurement and verified data to ensure the reliability of AI systems. These insights were provided as part of a broader industry forecast regarding the evolution of manufacturing technology.

items.title: Berenberg Raises Avio Target Price Following Tender Offer Announcement

items.content: In response to the voluntary tender offer for Avio S.p.A., analysts at Berenberg have raised their target price for the company's shares from €39 to €48. The firm has maintained its 'buy' rating on the stock, citing the industrial logic behind the proposed acquisition by ICEYE. Berenberg analysts noted that the potential for a vertically integrated European space group could provide significant upside, with some projections suggesting a potential valuation range of €50-€55 per share.

items.title: Brenntag SE Receives Voting Rights Notification from BlackRock, Inc.
items.summary: Brenntag SE has published a voting rights notification disclosing that BlackRock, Inc. has adjusted its stake in the company.
items.content: Brenntag SE released a formal voting rights notification pursuant to Section 40, Paragraph 1 of the German Securities Trading Act (WpHG). The disclosure indicates that BlackRock, Inc., based in Wilmington, Delaware, reached a threshold on November 19, 2026. Following this change, BlackRock's total voting rights in Brenntag SE amount to 5.45%, consisting of 4.95% in voting rights and 0.50% in financial instruments. The company's total number of voting rights is reported as 144,385,372.

items.title: Malaysia Aviation Group Selects GE Aerospace Engines for New Boeing 787 Dreamliners
items.summary: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has selected GE Aerospace's GEnx-1B engines to power up to 16 new Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft.
items.content: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) announced the selection of GEnx-1B engines to power its upcoming fleet of up to 16 Boeing 787 Dreamliners. This agreement marks the first time MAG has chosen GEnx engines for its operations. The selection was confirmed during a ceremony in Kuala Lumpur attended by Malaysian government officials. MAG also renewed its digital partnership with GE Aerospace, continuing the use of flight analytics software to support its long-haul network development.

items.title: Luzerner Kantonalbank Comments on ams-OSRAM Partnership
items.summary: Luzerner Kantonalbank (LUKB) analysts provided a perspective on the recent partnership between ams-OSRAM and Samsung, noting potential benefits while highlighting ongoing operational risks.
items.content: Luzerner Kantonalbank (LUKB) assessed the impact of the new partnership between ams-OSRAM and Samsung, acknowledging that the agreement strengthens the company's position. However, the bank cautioned investors regarding the challenging operational environment facing ams-OSRAM. Specifically, LUKB pointed to the risks associated with the company's strategic realignment and its continued high debt levels. This commentary follows recent market volatility for ams-OSRAM shares, which have been impacted by broader technology sector trends and concerns regarding the company's quarterly outlook.

items.title: Rémy Cointreau Reports First-Half 2026-27 Financial Results and Updates Outlook
items.summary: Rémy Cointreau announced its financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2026-27, reporting growth in current operating profit and raising its profitability outlook for the full year.
items.content: Rémy Cointreau reported first-half 2026-27 sales of €510.9 million, representing a 4.4% reported increase and 2.9% organic growth. Current operating profit reached €126.7 million, up 16.6% on a reported basis and 7.8% organically, exceeding analyst expectations. Despite a decline in net profit to €57.0 million, the company improved its current operating margin to 24.8%. Following these results, the group raised its full-year outlook, now forecasting a "solid" organic improvement in its current operating margin rather than the previously anticipated slight improvement. Additionally, the company provided long-term profitability targets, aiming for a current operating margin above 22% by 2031-2032.

items.content: Financial services firm Equita Sim has adjusted its outlook on Leonardo S.p.A., lowering the price target for the company's shares by 6% to 65 euros. The revision is attributed to mark-to-market valuation changes. The announcement was reported on November 25, 2026.

items.title: ams OSRAM Announces Strategic Partnership with Samsung Display
items.summary: ams OSRAM has entered into a strategic partnership with Samsung Display, involving a financial commitment from the Samsung subsidiary to support the company's Kulim 2 production facility.
items.content: ams OSRAM has formed a strategic partnership with Samsung Display, a move that includes the entry of the Samsung subsidiary into the opto-semiconductor company's operations. Under the agreement, Samsung will cover development costs and a portion of the annual fixed costs associated with the Kulim 2 plant in Malaysia. Analysts view the deal as a significant positive, noting that it provides a solution for the company's free cash flow pressures and offers a mid- to long-term revenue perspective in the triple-digit million-euro range. The partnership is expected to help bridge the time until revenue growth in the photonics sector for AI applications scales up, while leaving sufficient capacity for other business areas like intelligent glasses.

items.title: UBS Upgrades Swatch Group to Neutral
items.summary: UBS has upgraded its rating for Swatch Group from 'Sell' to 'Neutral', leading to a notable increase in the company's share price.
items.content: The Swiss financial institution UBS has upgraded its investment rating for Swatch Group, moving the stock from 'Sell' to 'Neutral'. Following this analyst action, Swatch Group shares experienced a significant increase of approximately 5% to 6% during the trading session on November 25, 2026. The upgrade is a key development for the company, as it reflects a shift in the bank's assessment of the watchmaker's market position. This analyst action was a primary driver of the stock's performance on the Swiss market during the day.

items.title: Bundeskartellamt Reviews Joint Venture Between TotalEnergies and Air Liquide
items.summary: The German Federal Cartel Office (Bundeskartellamt) is reviewing a merger control filing regarding the establishment of a jointly controlled venture between TotalEnergies NewMolecules Nederland B.V. and Air Liquide Industrie B.V.
items.content: The German Federal Cartel Office (Bundeskartellamt) has initiated a merger control proceeding concerning the formation of a jointly controlled joint venture involving TotalEnergies NewMolecules Nederland B.V. and Air Liquide Industrie B.V. The filing, registered under file number B8-115/26, was submitted on November 23, 2026. The venture is focused on the green product market. This regulatory review is a standard procedural step for the formation of new joint entities in Germany.

items.title: HBX Group Announces Full Year 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: HBX Group reported its fiscal year 2026 results, highlighting a 14% increase in Total Transaction Value (TTV) to €9.2 billion and a recommended final dividend of 11.5 cents per share.
items.content: HBX Group International plc announced its full-year 2026 financial results, reporting a 14% increase in Total Transaction Value (TTV) to €9.2 billion, despite an estimated 3-percentage-point adverse impact from the Middle East conflict. Revenue decreased 2% year-over-year at constant currency to €697 million, while Adjusted EBITDA fell 4% to €403 million with a 58% margin. The company achieved a profit after tax of €138 million, compared to a loss of €70 million in the previous fiscal year. The Board has recommended a final dividend of 11.5 cents per share. Looking ahead, the company expects double-digit TTV growth for Q1 2027, with revenue projected to decline modestly at constant currency.

items.content: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. (TMICC) issued a regulatory notification regarding a transaction by a person discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR). Mark O'Brien, the company's Chief Technology & Information Officer, purchased 3,500 ordinary shares at a price of £14.71 per share on November 23, 2026. The total value of the transaction was £51,485.00. This disclosure was made in compliance with the EU and UK versions of the Market Abuse Regulation 596/2014.

items.title: Danske Bank Acts as Sole Bookrunner and Financial Advisor for Herantis Pharma's Directed Share Issue
items.summary: Danske Bank A/S, Finland Branch is serving as the sole bookrunner and financial advisor for a directed share issue by Herantis Pharma Plc.
items.content: Danske Bank A/S, Finland Branch has been appointed as the sole bookrunner and financial advisor for a directed share issue conducted by the biotechnology company Herantis Pharma Plc. As part of the transaction, the company has agreed to certain restrictions on share issues and disposals, which are subject to the bank's prior written consent for a period of 180 days following the listing of the offer shares. The bank's role involves managing the offering process and providing financial advisory services to support the company's capital-raising objectives.

items.summary: Wipro has been selected by BP to modernize its finance operations, a move that includes the transfer of 3,000 employees to the IT services company.

items.title: nCino to Provide Lending Platform to Rabobank
items.summary: nCino, Inc. announced that it will offer its cloud-based platform to Rabobank to modernize and streamline the Dutch bank's business lending operations.
items.content: nCino, Inc. has announced a partnership to provide its platform to Coöperatieve Rabobank U.A., a major Dutch financial institution, to transform the bank's business lending landscape. The nCino platform will serve as a single loan origination system, intended to simplify lending operations and enable automated, tailored lending journeys for customers. By integrating nCino's AI and governance capabilities, Rabobank aims to scale AI across its lending lifecycle while maintaining human oversight. The initiative is designed to help the bank meet evolving customer expectations for speed and transparency while allowing relationship managers to focus on complex client needs.

items.title: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Workday Following Earnings Report
items.summary: Several financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs, DA Davidson, Evercore ISI, TD Cowen, and Bernstein, updated their price targets for Workday on November 25, 2026, following the company's recent quarterly earnings release.
items.content: Following Workday's fiscal third-quarter 2027 earnings announcement, multiple analysts adjusted their price targets for the company's stock. Goldman Sachs lowered its target to $163 from $164, while DA Davidson reduced its target to $170 from $190. Evercore ISI adjusted its target to $205 from $215, and TD Cowen lowered its target to $190 from $210. Conversely, Bernstein raised its price target to $239 from $238. These adjustments reflect the market's reaction to the company's latest financial performance and forward-looking disclosures.

items.title: Tradr ETFs Announces Upcoming Launch of Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF
items.summary: Tradr ETFs has announced plans to launch the "Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF" (Cboe: QUAT) on December 2, 2026, which will include D-Wave Quantum Inc. as a component stock.
items.content: Tradr ETFs, a provider of ETFs for professional traders, announced the upcoming launch of its "Triple Threat" series, which includes the Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF (Cboe: QUAT). This new fund is designed to provide 200% of the daily performance of an equally weighted basket of three quantum computing stocks, including D-Wave Quantum Inc. (QBTS), IonQ, Inc., and Rigetti Computing, Inc. The ETF is scheduled to begin trading on the Cboe on December 2, 2026. The fund will be rebalanced daily to maintain its target exposure.

items.content: On November 24, 2026, ARK Invest executed a sale of approximately $1.83 million worth of shares in the digital asset platform Bullish (BLSH). The transaction was conducted through the ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK). This divestment occurred alongside other portfolio adjustments by the firm, including the sale of shares in various cryptocurrency-related ETFs. The event reflects a change in institutional holdings for the company.

items.title: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF Featuring Rigetti Computing
items.summary: Tradr ETFs announced the upcoming launch of the Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF (Cboe: QUAT), which provides leveraged exposure to a basket of quantum computing stocks including Rigetti Computing, Inc.
items.content: Tradr ETFs has announced the planned launch of six new leveraged ETFs, scheduled for December 2, 2026, on the Cboe exchange. Among these is the Tradr Triple Threat 2X Long Quantum Daily ETF (Cboe: QUAT), which is designed to deliver 200% of the daily performance of an equally weighted basket of three stocks: IonQ, Inc., D-Wave Quantum Inc., and Rigetti Computing, Inc. The fund will rebalance its holdings daily. This launch is part of Tradr's new "Triple Threat" series, which focuses on providing leveraged exposure to specific industry sectors.

items.title: Cboe Clear Europe Sets Annual Record for Client Equity Trades Cleared
items.summary: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. announced that its pan-European central counterparty, Cboe Clear Europe, has cleared over 1.5 billion client equity trades year-to-date in 2026, surpassing its previous annual record.
items.content: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. reported that its subsidiary, Cboe Clear Europe, has cleared more than 1.5 billion client equity trades so far in 2026, exceeding the previous annual record of 1.49 billion set in 2022. items.title: Viavi Solutions Participates in ITRI's New 6G-FORMOSA Testing Platform
items.summary: Viavi Solutions has partnered with the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) to provide testing technology for the newly launched 6G-FORMOSA platform, which facilitates the development and validation of 6G technologies.
items.content: Viavi Solutions is contributing its testing capabilities to the 6G-FORMOSA platform, a shared testing environment launched by Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). The initiative aims to assist companies in developing and validating emerging 6G technologies for commercial use. As part of this collaboration, Viavi and the University of Malaga successfully completed two international joint trials involving low-altitude drone detection via a 6G ISAC base station and end-to-end NTN satellite communications. The platform, which includes 18 industry and academic partners, is designed to reduce investment duplication and accelerate development cycles for global organizations.

items.title: TransUnion Releases Q3 2026 Credit Industry Insights Report for Canada
items.summary: TransUnion's latest report indicates that Canadian consumers maintained stable credit conditions in Q3 2026, though record debt levels and upcoming mortgage renewals present potential affordability pressures.
items.content: TransUnion published its Q3 2026 Credit Industry Insights Report (CIIR) for Canada, noting that overall credit conditions remained near neutral during the third quarter. While the market is described as healthy, the report highlights that consumers are carrying record levels of debt. With a significant volume of mortgage renewals forecasted for 2027, TransUnion identified emerging affordability concerns for some borrowers. The analysis suggests that while delinquency rates remain low by historical standards, rising borrowing costs and larger mortgage balances are beginning to strain household budgets.

items.title: European Union Postpones Approval Discussion for Tesla's Self-Driving Technology
items.summary: The European Union has delayed a scheduled meeting to discuss the approval of Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology across the bloc until December 7.
items.content: The European Union has postponed a meeting intended to discuss the regulatory approval of Tesla's assisted self-driving technology across its member states. The discussion, which was expected to address the deployment of the company's Full Self-Driving (FSD) software, has been rescheduled for December 7. items.title: ITRI Launches 6G-FORMOSA Testbed in Collaboration with Keysight
items.summary: The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has launched 6G-FORMOSA, a shared testbed platform developed in collaboration with Keysight Technologies to accelerate 6G technology validation.
items.content: The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has introduced 6G-FORMOSA, a collaborative testbed platform designed to assist companies in developing and validating emerging 6G technologies for commercial use. Keysight Technologies is a key partner in this initiative, working with ITRI to connect the platform to international research networks, including the Victoria Network in Málaga, Spain, which is part of the EU's 6G-SANDBOX project. The platform aims to integrate Taiwanese-developed systems with international testing expertise to support innovation in areas such as integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), non-terrestrial networks (NTN), and multi-orbit satellite communications. By providing a unified environment for field validation and system integration, the project seeks to accelerate the commercial readiness of 6G solutions for industry partners.

The platform is already established as a production-proven solution, currently facilitating the delivery of gas, water, and electricity services to approximately 6 million consumers. By expanding the platform globally, CGI aims to provide utility companies with the tools necessary to enhance their operational efficiency and service delivery. This initiative is part of the company's ongoing efforts to provide end-to-end IT and business process services to its global client base.

items.title: Bravo Mining Reports Latest Assay Results from Luanga Deposit
items.summary: Bravo Mining Corp. announced assay results from 22 infill and step-out drill holes at its Luanga PGM+Au+Ni deposit in Brazil.
items.content: Bravo Mining Corp. has released assay results from twenty-two infill and step-out drill holes conducted at its 100% owned Luanga deposit in the Carajás Mineral Province, Brazil. The drilling program included ten holes from the Central Sector, five from the North Sector, and seven from the Southwest Sector. According to the company, these results demonstrate the potential to expand and upgrade the project's mineral resources, with some areas showing mineralization extensions up to twice the length of previous intercepts. Additionally, the company reported evidence of high-grade gold mineralization, which management suggests indicates remobilized mineralization within the deposit. Concurrently, the company's Copper-Gold Team has initiated a maiden drill program at the property targeting iron oxide copper gold and massive sulphide style mineralization.

items.title: INTERBETON, a Titan Group subsidiary, acquires Aggelos V. Peppas A.B.E.E.
items.summary: INTERBETON, a member of the Titan Group, has signed an agreement to acquire the Greek company Aggelos V. Peppas A.B.E.E. and its subsidiary Peppas Beton A.B.E.E.
items.content: INTERBETON, a subsidiary of Titan Group, has announced the signing of an agreement to acquire Aggelos V. Peppas A.B.E.E. and its subsidiary, Peppas Beton A.B.E.E. This acquisition is set to expand the company's ready-mix concrete network in the Attica region by adding three production units. The move is part of the Group's broader strategy to foster growth and further vertical integration within its key markets. Titan noted that this agreement complements its ongoing investments in vertical integration over the past three years, aimed at strengthening its national supply chain and supporting major infrastructure, commercial, and residential projects.

items.title: BBVA Argentina Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. reported its consolidated financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting key performance metrics including net income, return on equity, and asset quality.
items.content: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. released its consolidated financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The bank reported an inflation-adjusted net income of $58.9 billion for the period. Key performance indicators included an average return on equity (ROE) of 4.9% and an average return on assets (ROA) of 0.7%. The bank's net interest margin (NIM) was 15.1%, while the non-performing loan (NPL) ratio reached 5.55% with a coverage ratio of 82.26%. Additionally, the bank maintained a regulatory capital ratio of 17.9%, exceeding minimum requirements.

items.title: Marimaca Copper Secures Investment Committee Approval for US$450 Million Financing Package
items.summary: Marimaca Copper Corp. announced that its subsidiary has received investment committee approval from Sprott Resource Lending Corp. for a US$450 million financing package to support the construction of the Marimaca Oxide Deposit in Chile.
items.content: Marimaca Copper Corp. has secured investment committee approval from Sprott Resource Lending Corp. for a US$450 million financing package, consisting of a US$425 million project finance facility and a US$25 million equity investment. The funds are intended to support the construction of the Marimaca Oxide Deposit (MOD) located in the Antofagasta region of Chile. The financing remains subject to the completion of due diligence, the negotiation and execution of definitive documentation, and the satisfaction of customary conditions precedent. The project finance facility does not require hedging, cash sweeps, or production-linked payments.

items.title: UBS Group AG Discloses 5.17% Stake in Sibanye-Stillwater
items.summary: Sibanye-Stillwater has received formal notification that UBS Group AG has increased its beneficial interest in the company's common shares to 5.17%.
items.content: Sibanye-Stillwater announced on November 25, 2026, that it received a formal notification regarding a change in the beneficial ownership of its securities. UBS Group AG has acquired a stake in the company, resulting in a total holding of 5.17% of Sibanye-Stillwater's issued common shares. In accordance with the South African Companies Act and JSE Limited Listings Requirements, the company has filed the necessary disclosure with the Takeover Regulation Panel. The board of Sibanye-Stillwater has confirmed the accuracy of the information received via the TRP121.1 forms.

items.title: Sun Yu of Bank of China (Hong Kong) Discusses Renminbi Internationalization
items.summary: Sun Yu, vice-chairman and chief executive of Bank of China (Hong Kong) Ltd, highlighted the growing role of the renminbi in the global monetary system at the Financial Street Forum 2026.
items.content: Speaking at the Annual Conference of Financial Street Forum 2026, Sun Yu, vice-chairman and chief executive of Bank of China (Hong Kong) Ltd, addressed the shifting landscape of global trade and supply chains. He noted that an increasingly complex and volatile international environment is driving demand for a more diversified, stable, and secure monetary system. Sun emphasized that these global changes are creating new opportunities for the renminbi to expand its international role.

items.title: Cisco and Quali Announce Full-Stack Automation Blueprints
items.summary: Cisco and Quali have introduced new full-stack automation blueprints for Cisco AI PODs, FlexPod, and Splunk PODs to accelerate infrastructure deployment.
items.content: Cisco and Quali have launched new full-stack automation blueprints designed to extend deployment automation across compute, networking, storage, and software. These solutions, which include the Cisco Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, are orderable through Cisco and built on Quali's Torque platform. The initiative aims to help organizations automate the deployment of complex data center, AI, and edge infrastructure, reducing manual integration work. items.content: In a feature on manufacturing trends for 2027, TE Connectivity executives shared perspectives on the industry's digital transformation. items.title: RBC Releases Fall 2026 Financial Flexibility Poll Results
items.summary: RBC published its Fall 2026 Financial Flexibility Poll, revealing that 58% of Canadians with available cash to invest are held back by a 'fear of messing up' rather than a fear of missing out.
items.content: The RBC Financial Flexibility Poll – Fall 2026 Edition highlights that while 59% of Canadians have cash available to invest, many remain on the sidelines due to anxiety about making the 'right' investment decisions. The survey found that 58% of those with investable cash are more afraid of making mistakes than missing out on market opportunities. Additionally, the bank announced a promotional offer for new and existing clients, providing up to $10,000 in value—equivalent to 500,000 Avion points—for those who invest with RBC before March 31, 2027. The findings underscore a significant gap in investment confidence, with only 25% of non-investors feeling confident in achieving their future financial goals compared to 66% of current investors.

items.title: Deere & Company Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Deere & Company announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year ended November 1, 2026, reporting quarterly net income of $1.051 billion.
items.content: Deere & Company reported net income of $1.051 billion, or $3.89 per share, for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, compared to $1.065 billion, or $3.93 per share, in the same period last year. Quarterly revenue reached $10.514 billion, a slight decrease from the $10.579 billion reported in the prior year's fourth quarter. For the full fiscal year 2026, the company recorded a total net income of $4.860 billion. Looking ahead, Deere & Company provided a fiscal 2027 outlook, forecasting net income to be in the range of $4.50 billion to $5.25 billion. CEO John May characterized the results as demonstrating the strength of the company's Smart Industrial operating model, noting that the company maintained disciplined execution and continued capital returns to shareholders despite cyclical lows.

items.title: Bank of America Marks 75th Anniversary in Switzerland

The bank reported significant expansion in the region, including tripling its Swiss corporate banking client base since January 2024 and doubling its local headcount since the launch of a growth initiative in 2021. The Swiss business has expanded to include strengthened Financial Institutions Group coverage, broader corporate banking capabilities, and an increased middle-market offering. The bank also noted its role in several recent significant transactions, including advisory work for Lonza and ABB, as well as capital markets activities for companies such as Galderma and Nestlé.

items.title: Malaysia Regulator Files Lawsuits Against Google Seeking $145.8 Million
items.summary: The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission has initiated two lawsuits against Alphabet's Google, seeking $145.8 million in damages for alleged failures to remove harmful content from YouTube.
items.content: The Malaysian regulator is seeking 300 million ringgit, approximately $72.9 million, in each of the two lawsuits, citing Google's failure to adequately address harmful content such as online gambling, scams, and fraud. The commission reported submitting over 74,000 reports to YouTube between January and October 2026, alleging that many were not addressed or were handled with significant delays. One of the suits also concerns the republication of content by a social-media personality despite a court injunction. The legal action reflects the regulator's efforts to hold the platform accountable for content moderation failures.

items.title: Andika Rama Wins TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Asia Esports GT Championship 2026
items.summary: Indonesian sim racer Andika Rama secured his third championship title at the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Asia Esports GT Championship 2026 Asia Finals in Kuala Lumpur.
items.content: Andika Rama successfully defended his title at the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing (TGR) Asia Esports GT Championship 2026, completing a clean sweep of all three races in the Asia Finals held in Kuala Lumpur. This victory marks Rama's third championship crown, following his previous wins in 2023 and 2025. Indonesia also claimed the country title in the competition, which featured 15 drivers from five Asian countries competing for a USD 31,000 prize pool. The event highlights TOYOTA GAZOO Racing's ongoing commitment to fostering motorsport talent and engaging with the global sim racing community.

items.title: South Korean Government Launches Training Program to Address Semiconductor Labor Shortage
items.summary: The South Korean government is partnering with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to address a projected shortage of 260,000 skilled workers for semiconductor plant construction by 2030.
items.content: To support the expansion of semiconductor manufacturing facilities, the South Korean government has established a public-private advisory body with Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and other industry partners. The initiative aims to mitigate a labor shortage of 260,000 workers required for next-generation chip plants by 2030. Measures include a new public-private training program for graduates and efforts to re-employ retired skilled workers and military veterans in construction roles. Samsung is currently expanding its P5 production line at the Pyeongtaek campus and planning new projects in the Honam region.

The transaction details were disclosed in a news release dated November 25, 2026.

items.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are reportedly exploring the adoption of YMTC's Xtacking technology for their 3D NAND memory production.
items.content: According to reports, both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are evaluating the potential use of YMTC's proprietary Xtacking technology for 3D NAND flash memory manufacturing. This development suggests a potential shift in strategy as the companies look to optimize their NAND production capabilities. The report highlights the ongoing competitive landscape in the memory chip industry, where firms are continuously seeking technological advancements to maintain performance and cost efficiency. No further details regarding the status of any potential agreements or implementation timelines were disclosed.

items.title: BNP Paribas Participates in €1.2 Billion Credit Facility for Amplifon
items.summary: BNP Paribas acted as one of the mandated lead arrangers and bookrunners for a new €1.2 billion credit facility secured by the Italian hearing solutions group Amplifon.
items.content: BNP Paribas, alongside a pool of other international banks, served as a mandated lead arranger and bookrunner for a €1.2 billion financing package for Amplifon. The credit facility consists of a €900 million term loan amortizing over five years and a €300 million revolving credit line. These resources are intended to support Amplifon's acquisition of GN Hearing and to refinance existing debt, including a €350 million bond maturing in 2027. The transaction is part of Amplifon's broader financial strategy to complete its acquisition of the Danish hearing business.

items.title: Li Auto Inc. Announces Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Li Auto reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting a 7.2% year-over-year increase in vehicle deliveries and a narrowed net loss.
items.content: Li Auto Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total vehicle deliveries of 99,964 units, representing a 7.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Revenue rose to 28.83 billion yuan, while the net loss narrowed to 314.1 million yuan from 625.0 million yuan in the prior-year period. Gross margin improved to 16.7% from 16.3% a year earlier. For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company provided guidance projecting vehicle deliveries between 110,000 and 115,000 units and total revenue between 31.7 billion yuan and 33.1 billion yuan.

items.title: Joybuy Launches Christmas Campaign and New Shopping Features
items.summary: JD.com's European retail platform, Joybuy, has introduced new holiday shopping features and announced a upcoming Christmas campaign titled 'It's a you kind of Christmas'.
items.content: Joybuy, the European online retail business of JD.com, has introduced new features for the holiday season, including gift boxing, shareable wishlists, and festive surprises, with delivery services available up to Christmas Eve. Additionally, the company announced that it will launch a new Christmas campaign on December 1, 2026, titled 'It's a you kind of Christmas'. The campaign will feature a series of films highlighting various holiday shopping personalities and habits, emphasizing the platform's role in facilitating personalized gifting experiences.

items.title: Prosus Reports First-Half Earnings Miss
items.summary: Prosus N.V. reported a decline in first-half adjusted EBITDA and net profit, missing analyst expectations as gains from Tencent share sales decreased.
items.content: Prosus N.V. announced its financial results for the first half of the 2025/27 fiscal year, reporting a 7% year-over-year decline in adjusted EBITDA to $393 million. Net profit for the period fell by more than 25%, a decline the company attributed primarily to a $2.5 billion reduction in gains from the disposal of Tencent shares compared to the prior period. The results fell short of analyst expectations, leading to a decline in the company's share price. Management noted that the company has been implementing cost-saving measures in recent months to address performance challenges, including the impact of investments in the food delivery sector.

items.title: Sony Network Communications Europe and Nimway Launch SENVY AI Multi-Sensor
items.summary: Sony Network Communications Europe and its Nimway platform have introduced SENVY, a new wireless, battery-powered AI multi-sensor designed for workplace intelligence.
items.content: Sony Network Communications Europe and Nimway have announced the launch of SENVY, an AI-driven multi-sensor device that integrates precision people counting, object-based occupancy detection, and CO2 air quality monitoring. The device is designed to support corporate real estate leaders and facility managers in making data-driven portfolio decisions by providing granular workplace intelligence. Developed within Sony's established AI ethics and governance framework, SENVY operates as part of the broader Nimway platform, which processes over 100 million workplace events daily. The launch is positioned as a strategic expansion of Nimway's capabilities, offering a wireless, battery-powered solution that integrates with existing sensor families and third-party systems via open APIs.

items.title: NIO Hosts 2026 Innovation Technology Day, Outlines AI-Native Strategy and Energy Growth Targets
items.summary: NIO held its 2026 Innovation Technology Day, announcing a strategic shift toward becoming an AI-native organization and projecting significant growth for its energy infrastructure by 2030.
items.content: At the 2026 Innovation Technology Day, NIO founder and CEO William Li announced that the company has invested over 72 billion RMB in R&D over the past 12 years. The company is transitioning into an 'AI-native organization,' integrating AI across R&D, manufacturing, logistics, and user services, with over 7,500 AI agents currently deployed. Reported efficiency gains include a 13% increase in R&D personnel efficiency and a 23% improvement in inventory turnover. Looking toward 2030, NIO projects its energy division will manage battery assets valued at over 350 billion RMB, operate more than 10,000 battery swapping stations, and facilitate over 10 billion kWh of annual charging and swapping consumption.

items.title: PayerMax Integrates Standard Chartered's FX Scale Service
items.summary: Global payments company PayerMax has integrated Standard Chartered's FX Scale foreign exchange service to enhance its cross-border transaction capabilities.
items.content: PayerMax has incorporated Standard Chartered's FX Scale foreign exchange service into its payment infrastructure to support global connectivity through hubs in Singapore and Hong Kong. The partnership provides PayerMax with host-to-host and API connectivity, as well as multicurrency virtual accounts and bulk payout capabilities. This integration is designed to assist merchants in managing cross-border fund flows and transactions more effectively. The collaboration leverages Standard Chartered's financial network to support PayerMax's merchant-focused payment services across international markets.

items.title: GSK's Exdensur Meets Primary Endpoint in Late-Stage Study for EGPA
items.summary: GSK announced that its potential inflammatory disease treatment, Exdensur, successfully met the primary endpoint in a late-stage non-inferiority clinical trial for eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA).
items.content: GSK reported that its investigational treatment, Exdensur, achieved its primary endpoint in a late-stage clinical trial evaluating its efficacy in patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA). The study was designed as a non-inferiority trial, and the results indicate that the treatment is comparable to the company's existing approved therapy for this rare immune disorder. This development marks a significant milestone in the company's efforts to expand its portfolio of treatments for inflammatory diseases. Further details regarding the trial data and subsequent regulatory steps are expected to follow as the company advances the program.

items.title: Gaotu Techedu Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
items.summary: Gaotu Techedu Inc. reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting a return to GAAP operating profitability.
items.content: Gaotu Techedu Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting net revenues of RMB 1,868.4 million, an 18.3% increase year-over-year. The company achieved an income from operations of RMB 1.1 million, compared to an operating loss of RMB 178.0 million in the same period of 2025. Net income for the quarter was RMB 15.6 million, marking a turnaround from a net loss of RMB 147.1 million in the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP net income reached RMB 23.1 million, compared to a non-GAAP net loss of RMB 137.7 million in the prior year. Gross billings for the period were RMB 1,257.3 million, representing a 5.8% increase from the third quarter of 2025.

items.title: Autotrader Shares Slip as Amazon Plans U.K. Launch of Car-Buying Platform
items.summary: Shares of Autotrader fell 1.2% following Amazon's announcement that it will launch its Amazon Autos car-buying platform in the U.K. early next year.
items.content: Autotrader Group plc shares declined by 1.2% in early London trading on November 25, 2026, after Amazon.com announced plans to expand its Amazon Autos platform into the U.K. market in early 2027. The Amazon Autos service, which currently operates in the U.S., will allow U.K. customers to browse real-time dealer inventory, view upfront pricing, obtain trade-in valuations, and review financing options. Amazon has named Hyundai as its first launch partner for the U.K. service, with additional inventory to be provided by dealer group Vertu Motors. The company stated that further brands and dealerships will be announced ahead of the official launch.

items.title: MiniMax Releases 100-Day Performance Data for H3 Video Generation Model
items.summary: MiniMax announced that its H3 video generation model has reached 1,472 derivative models and over 148 million cumulative downloads in its first 100 days of open-source availability.
items.content: MiniMax has released performance data covering the first 100 days since the open-source release of its H3 video generation model. The company reported that developers have built 1,472 derivative models based on H3, which have collectively surpassed 148 million downloads. The H3 Family of models includes the flagship H3 and H3-Image series, alongside various third-party and community-developed extensions. These models are utilized across diverse sectors, including e-commerce, gaming, film, television, and industrial design. MiniMax also highlighted that major technology firms and academic institutions have participated in developing H3-based derivatives, and the company plans to continue expanding the H3 Family to support global developers.

items.title: easyJet Reports 96% Profit Decline Amid Fuel Cost Pressures
items.summary: easyJet reported a 96% drop in profit, citing significant fuel cost increases and a challenging geopolitical environment.
items.content: The airline experienced a substantial 96% decline in profit, largely attributed to rising fuel costs and the impact of the ongoing war on travel demand. While late-season bookings showed strength, they were insufficient to offset weaker performance earlier in the year when holidaymakers reduced travel plans. The company did not provide financial guidance for the upcoming year, noting that with a buyer currently lined up, such projections are no longer required. The report highlights that easyJet's fuel hedging strategy, which covered approximately 70% of its 2026 fuel needs, left it more exposed to cost volatility compared to some industry peers.

items.title: U.K. Regulator Signals Potential Path Forward for McCormick-Unilever Foods Merger
items.summary: The U.K. Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) indicated that McCormick's proposed divestiture of the Colman's brand could resolve competition concerns regarding its $65 billion merger with Unilever Foods.
items.content: The U.K. markets regulator has stated that the proposed sale of the Colman's brand by McCormick could address competition concerns identified during its investigation into the planned $65 billion merger with Unilever Foods. The CMA is now reviewing the divestiture proposal in greater detail. Colman's, which produces dry sauces, cooking ingredient mixes, mustard, and cold sauces, was identified as a point of concern due to potential market overlap. A Unilever spokesperson noted that the company had already planned to market the Colman's assets to proactively manage competition issues and that discussions with potential buyers are progressing well. Both companies expressed confidence that the merger remains on track for a timely closing.

items.title: Alkermes to Participate in the 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Alkermes plc announced that its management team will participate in a fireside chat at the 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference on December 2, 2026.
items.content: Alkermes plc has confirmed that company management will take part in a fireside chat at the 9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference. The event is scheduled to occur on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 11:15 a.m. ET. Interested parties can access a live webcast of the session through the Investors section of the company's official website. The presentation will be available for replay in an archived format for a period of 14 days following the conference.

items.title: Alibaba Reportedly in Preliminary Discussions for Offshore Bond Sale
items.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited has reportedly held preliminary discussions with investment banks regarding a potential debt issuance in offshore yuan and dollars for 2027.
items.content: Alibaba is exploring a potential sale of debt notes in offshore yuan and dollars, according to reports citing people familiar with the matter. The company has engaged in preliminary discussions with investment banks to weigh the financing options for 2027. As of the report, the company had not provided a formal response to the news. This development reflects the company's ongoing assessment of its capital structure and international financing opportunities.

items.title: China Construction Bank Participates in €1.2 Billion Credit Facility for Amplifon
items.summary: China Construction Bank (Europe) S.A., Milan Branch, is among the financial institutions providing a €1.2 billion credit facility to support Amplifon's acquisition of GN Hearing.
items.content: China Construction Bank (Europe) S.A., Milan Branch, has joined a syndicate of international financial institutions to provide a €1.2 billion credit facility to Amplifon. The financing package, which includes a 5-year amortizing term loan and a revolving credit line, is intended to finalize the funding structure for Amplifon's acquisition of GN Hearing A/S. The credit facility will be used to fund the cash portion of the acquisition consideration and to refinance existing debt. The transaction involves a broad pool of banks acting as lead arrangers, including China Construction Bank, to support the strategic acquisition expected to close by the end of 2026.

items.title: Zentra Group plc Announces Proposed Recapitalisation and General Meeting
items.summary: Zentra Group plc has announced a proposed recapitalisation involving a £5.5 million debt waiver and a debt-for-equity conversion with OH UK Holdings Limited.
items.content: Zentra Group plc has announced a proposed recapitalisation transaction to address its debt position. Under the proposal, OH UK Holdings Limited (OHUK) will waive £5,500,000 of debt and convert an additional £440,000 of debt into 16,000,000 new ordinary shares at a price of 2.75 pence per share. This transaction is expected to extinguish £5,940,000 of debt, improve the company's net asset position, and reduce annual interest costs by approximately £356,400. The company has scheduled a General Meeting to consider the necessary resolutions. Following the conversion, OHUK will hold a 29.26% stake in the company.

items.title: Zentra Group plc Posts Annual Report and Notice of AGM

items.content: Zentra Group plc has posted its Annual Report and Accounts for the financial year ended 30 June 2026 to shareholders. The company also issued the formal Notice of Annual General Meeting (AGM), which is scheduled to be held on 17 December 2026 in Manchester. A General Meeting (GM) will follow the AGM to consider resolutions regarding the company's proposed recapitalisation. The documents are available for download on the company's website.

items.title: Genedrive plc Announces Audited Final Results for the Year Ended 30 June 2026
items.summary: Genedrive plc reported a 40% increase in revenue to £1.4 million and a reduced loss after tax of £4.2 million for the 2026 fiscal year.
items.content: Genedrive plc announced its audited final results for the year ended 30 June 2026, highlighting a transition from development to broader commercial implementation. Revenue and other income grew by 40% to £1.4 million, compared to £1.0 million in the previous year. The company reported a reduced loss after tax of £4.2 million, down from £5.2 million in 2025, which management attributed to a realignment of the cost base. Diagnostics expenditure remained significant at £3.2 million, supporting the commercial adoption of its diagnostic products. The company also noted that approximately 74% of its income was generated in the UK, with 26% coming from international markets.

items.title: Kromek Group plc Enters Partnership with Spectara for Biological Threat Detection
items.summary: Kromek Group plc has partnered with Spectara to distribute its biological threat detection system internationally, integrating the BioTOF z200 mass spectrometry system into its portfolio.
items.content: Kromek Group plc has entered into a partnership with Spectara to distribute its biological threat detection system in international markets. The agreement incorporates the BioTOF z200, a commercially available MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry system, into Kromek's existing biological detection portfolio. This addition complements Kromek's ongoing development of DNA sequencing technology, allowing the company to offer customers two distinct but complementary approaches to biological threat detection. While the BioTOF z200 provides rapid anomaly detection of known threats through automated sampling, Kromek's DNA sequencing technology is designed to provide more detailed genomic analysis and the identification of previously unknown pathogens. The system is capable of continuous monitoring for over four weeks without human intervention and is supported by cloud-based data management.

items.title: SMX Expands Plastic Circularity Platform with Digital Plastic Passport and Marketplace
items.summary: SMX is expanding its Plastic Circularity Platform to include a Digital Plastic Passport and a Global Circularity Marketplace, supported by a collaboration with A*STAR.
items.content: SMX (Security Matters) PLC has introduced a Digital Plastic Passport and a Global Circularity Marketplace to connect certified recycled materials with digital records and commercial buyers. The initiative expands upon the company's Digital Material Passport Platform, which links physical molecular markers to secure digital records for traceability. SMX is also collaborating with Singapore's Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) to validate and optimize the platform for broader industrial adoption. Additionally, the company plans to host an onboarding event for the Digital Plastic Passport in collaboration with the World Business Council for Sustainable Development (WBCSD) on November 27, 2026.

items.title: PCI-PAL PLC Appoints Haywood Chapman as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: PCI-PAL has appointed Haywood Chapman as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately, succeeding Ryan Murray.
items.content: PCI-PAL PLC announced the appointment of Haywood Chapman as Chief Financial Officer, effective 24 November 2026. Chapman brings over 26 years of financial and accountancy experience, including previous CFO roles at IQGeo Group plc and Castleton Technology plc. He succeeds Ryan Murray, who has stepped down by mutual agreement to support an orderly transition. Chapman will stand for election at the company's next Annual General Meeting.

items.title: Reach plc Partners with Tickaroo for Interactive Live Coverage
items.summary: Reach plc has selected Tickaroo's media software to enhance its national and regional brands with interactive live coverage features.
items.content: Reach plc has entered into a partnership with Tickaroo, a news and sports media software provider, to integrate interactive live coverage tools across its portfolio of national and regional news brands. The platform will support live blogging, audience participation features such as polls and quizzes, and multimedia content for events ranging from major sports matches to entertainment shows. According to Paul Rowland, Editorial Director (News) at Reach, the initiative aims to provide journalists with tools to deliver more engaging, tailored content that reflects audience interests. The company expects this collaboration to strengthen audience engagement and create new commercial opportunities through advertising, sponsorships, and subscriptions.

The company also issued the notice for its Annual General Meeting (AGM), which is scheduled to take place on 17 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. in London.
