items.title: PCI-PAL PLC Grants Share Options to CFO Haywood Chapman
items.summary: The remuneration committee of PCI-PAL has approved a grant of 938,000 options to newly appointed CFO Haywood Chapman under the company's Long-Term Incentive Plan.
items.content: PCI-PAL PLC's remuneration committee approved a grant of 938,000 options to CFO Haywood Chapman on 24 November 2026, with an exercise price of 1.0 pence per share. The award consists of 868,000 performance-conditioned options linked to share-price targets and adjusted EBITDA, vesting on the third anniversary, and 70,000 time-based options vesting on the second anniversary. This grant is subject to continued employment and represents potential future dilution for shareholders.

items.title: PCI-PAL PLC Announces FY26 Full Year Results
items.summary: PCI-PAL reported FY26 revenue of £25.36 million, a 13% increase, alongside an adjusted EBITDA of £1.72 million.
items.content: PCI-PAL PLC announced its financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026, reporting revenue of £25.36 million, a 13% increase, and an adjusted EBITDA of £1.72 million. The company achieved an Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of £24.78 million, up 29%, and a Committed Annual Recurring Revenue (CARR) of £27.86 million, up 25%. Statutory loss before tax was £0.52 million, while adjusted loss before tax was £0.07 million. Management highlighted record new business performance, particularly in North America, and noted that 79% of new contracts were generated through its partner ecosystem.

items.title: Beacon Rise Holdings plc Announces Intention to Delist from London Stock Exchange and Move to AIM
items.summary: Beacon Rise Holdings plc has announced its intention to cancel its listing on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market to pursue admission to the AIM market, concurrent with its proposed acquisition of Dr Kerry Sissins Chiropractor Limited.
items.content: Beacon Rise Holdings plc has formally notified the Financial Conduct Authority and the London Stock Exchange of its intention to delist its ordinary shares from the Main Market. The company plans for the delisting to become effective on December 22, 2026, with the final day of trading on the Main Market expected to be December 21, 2026. This strategic move is intended to facilitate the company's application for admission to trading on the AIM market. The transition is being pursued in conjunction with the company's previously announced proposed acquisition of Dr Kerry Sissins Chiropractor Limited, which is classified as an initial transaction under UK Listing Rules. Further details regarding the acquisition and the transition process are expected to be provided to shareholders in due course.

items.title: Redcentric Announces Date for Interim Results
items.summary: Redcentric plc has scheduled the release of its interim financial results for the six months ended 30 September 2026 for 8 December 2026.
items.content: Redcentric plc announced that it will report its interim results for the six-month period ending 30 September 2026 on 8 December 2026. The company will host an in-person presentation for analysts at 9:30 a.m. (GMT) on the day of the announcement, led by CEO Michelle Senecal de Fonseca and CFO Tim Sykes. Additionally, a retail investor presentation featuring a live Q&A session is scheduled for 10 December 2026 at 1:00 p.m. (GMT) via the Investor Meet Company platform.

items.title: Acuity RM Group Announces Share Subscription
items.summary: Acuity RM Group plc has agreed to a share subscription of 6,666,667 ordinary shares at 1.5 pence per share, raising £100,000 from a UK smaller companies fund.
items.content: Acuity RM Group plc announced a share subscription agreement for 6,666,667 ordinary shares at a price of 1.5 pence each, totaling £100,000 in proceeds. The subscriber will also receive a warrant to purchase an additional 6,666,667 ordinary shares at an exercise price of 1.875 pence, exercisable for 18 months following the admission of the subscription shares. The company stated that while it was not actively seeking equity for its existing business due to recent contract wins and warrant exercises, it pursued the subscription to secure a leading UK smaller companies fund as an investor. Admission of the new shares to trading on AIM is expected on or around November 30, 2026.

items.title: Acuity RM Group Announces Warrant Exercise
items.summary: Acuity RM Group plc received a warrant exercise notice for 3,000,000 ordinary shares at 1.5 pence per share, generating £45,000 in proceeds.
items.content: Acuity RM Group plc announced the receipt of a warrant exercise notice for 3,000,000 ordinary shares at an exercise price of 1.5 pence per share, resulting in total consideration of £45,000. The company noted that November 23, 2026, was the final date for the exercise of warrants issued during the May 2025 fundraising. Of the 42,107,143 warrants issued at that time, 20,250,000 were exercised in total, while the remaining 21,857,143 have expired. Following the admission of these new shares, which is expected on or around November 30, 2026, the company's total number of voting rights will be 352,660,482.

items.title: Karelian Diamond Resources Announces Results of Annual General Meeting
items.summary: Karelian Diamond Resources held its annual general meeting on November 23, 2026, where all proposed resolutions were passed by shareholders.
items.content: Karelian Diamond Resources announced that all resolutions presented at its annual general meeting held on November 23, 2026, were duly passed by shareholders on a poll. Following the conclusion of these resolutions, the meeting was adjourned until November 30, 2026. The adjourned meeting will focus on reviewing the company's affairs and considering the financial statements for the year ended May 31, 2026, along with the associated directors' and independent auditor's reports. Additionally, the company noted that a presentation by its senior geologist was delivered to investors during the event.

items.title: BRCK Group Reports H1 FY27 Interim Results
items.summary: BRCK Group announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, reporting revenue of £343.1 million and adjusted EBITDA of £25.5 million.
items.content: BRCK Group reported revenue of £343.1 million for the first half of fiscal year 2027, representing a 1.1% decrease year-on-year. Adjusted EBITDA fell 6.3% to £25.5 million, while adjusted profit before tax declined 14.8% to £17.9 million. The company reported a statutory profit before tax of £10.6 million and adjusted EPS of 4.06p, down 15.2%. Net debt increased to £96.4 million, primarily attributed to the acquisition of H.S. Jackson & Son (Fencing) Limited. Management highlighted a strategic focus on simplifying the group structure, targeting at least £5 million in recurring cost savings, and prioritizing debt reduction amid challenging UK housebuilding market conditions.

items.title: Huddled Group Announces £900,000 Equity Subscription to Fund Live Commerce Strategy
items.summary: Huddled Group plc has secured initial commitments of approximately £900,000 through a proposed share subscription at 0.45p per share to accelerate its live commerce growth.
items.content: Huddled Group plc has announced a proposed subscription for new ordinary shares at 0.45 pence per share, aiming to raise approximately £900,000. The capital is intended to support the company's live commerce strategy, including funding stock purchases, migrating fulfillment operations to THG Fulfil, and increasing marketing efforts. The company reported significant growth in its live commerce division, noting that daily revenue has reached approximately £25,000 and that its Peeko Gadgets brand has seen strong performance since its launch on the Whatnot platform in August 2026. Trading in the company's shares was temporarily suspended on November 24, 2026, pending the announcement of this financing.

items.title: Quantum Blockchain Technologies Secures Loan Facility and Receives Asset Recovery Payment
items.summary: Quantum Blockchain Technologies Plc has entered into a new loan facility with its largest shareholder and received a final payment from the bankruptcy proceedings of a legacy Italian asset.
items.content: Quantum Blockchain Technologies Plc has secured a loan facility of up to €250,000 from its largest shareholder, MC Strategies AG, to support liquidity. The company may draw on this facility in tranches of at least €50,000 between January 1, 2027, and March 30, 2027. Additionally, the company's subsidiary, Clear Leisure 2017 Limited, received €132,067 from the receiver of Mediapolis S.r.l. as the final distribution under a June 2020 settlement agreement. This payment concludes the recovery of €1,663,000 from the Mediapolis bankruptcy procedure.

items.title: Virax Biolabs Expands Fosun Diagnostics Supply Agreement to India
items.summary: Virax Biolabs has signed a supplemental agreement to extend its commercial supply framework for ImmuneSelect products to include India, covering a total of seven markets.
items.content: Virax Biolabs Group Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Virax Biolabs (UK) Limited, has signed a supplemental agreement with Fosun Diagnostics to expand their commercial supply framework for ImmuneSelect research-use immune profiling products to India. This expansion brings the total number of markets covered under the agreement to seven, including India, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Malaysia. The company noted that customer sampling is currently underway in Thailand, Singapore, and the Philippines, and that it has received inquiries from Indian customers regarding its peptide pools. Additionally, the company is in preliminary discussions with Fosun regarding potential distribution in mainland China and local manufacturing at a Fosun facility.

items.title: Gunsynd Reports Drilling Results from Richmond Hill Resources' Sakoose Project
items.summary: Gunsynd PLC provided an update on the diamond-drill campaign at the Sakoose project, noting that 1,292 meters have been drilled with initial assay results reported.
items.content: Gunsynd PLC, which holds approximately 2.6% of Richmond Hill Resources Plc, announced progress on the Sakoose diamond-drill campaign. As of the report, 1,292 meters of an approximately 1,400-meter program have been drilled, with 766 meters of core logged. Initial rush-assayed results include 0.67 meters at 54.2 g/t Au and a 5.84-meter composite at 1.16 g/t Au. Remaining samples from the campaign are currently pending analysis. The company noted that true widths for the reported intervals have not yet been determined.

items.title: BRCK Group Directors Purchase Ordinary Shares
items.summary: Chief Financial Officer Mike Gant and Independent Non-Executive Director Katie Long have purchased ordinary shares in BRCK Group plc.
items.content: BRCK Group announced that CFO Mike Gant purchased 92,114 ordinary shares at a price of 32.568 pence per share, bringing his total beneficial interest to 354,562 shares, or approximately 0.11% of the company's issued share capital. Additionally, Independent Non-Executive Director Katie Long purchased 90,592 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 33.115 pence per share. These transactions represent board-level buying activity within the company.

items.title: Bradda Head Lithium Announces Assay Results from Whistlejacket Project
items.summary: Bradda Head Lithium reported assay results from drillhole WSTL0022 at its Whistlejacket Lithium Project, confirming significant lithium mineralization.
items.content: Bradda Head Lithium has announced assay results from drillhole WSTL0022, the third hole of its 2026 drilling campaign at the Whistlejacket Lithium Project. The project is being developed under an option to joint venture agreement with Kennecott Exploration Company. Drillhole WSTL0022 successfully intersected the main mineralized pegmatite up-dip of a previous hole, WSTL0020. The results returned 38.13 meters at 1.34% Li₂O, including a higher-grade interval of 23.39 meters.

items.title: Conroy Gold Announces Drilling Results at Clay Lake
items.summary: Conroy Gold and Natural Resources plc reported results from a two-hole diamond drilling programme at the Clay Lake gold target in County Armagh, Northern Ireland, identifying an extensive mineralised system.
items.content: Conroy Gold and Natural Resources plc has announced the results of a two-hole diamond drilling programme at its Clay Lake gold target in County Armagh, Northern Ireland. The drilling, which totaled 969.2 metres, was designed to test the gold system beyond previously explored zones as part of the company's effort to evaluate the 7.5 km corridor between Clay Lake and the Clontibret gold deposit. The programme successfully intersected 24 gold zones at or above 0.25 g/t Au and identified an extensive sulphide-bearing system extending to approximately 400 metres below the surface. Notable intersections included 26.0 metres at 0.36 g/t Au and 8.5 metres at 0.55 g/t Au. The company noted that the system remains open at depth and to the south-west.

items.title: Defence Holdings PLC Secures MoD Contract Extension and Reports Commercial Progress
items.summary: Defence Holdings PLC has secured a contract extension with the UK Ministry of Defence and announced the inaugural investment by the Defence Fund into Inexorable.
items.content: Defence Holdings PLC announced a £113,000 contract extension with the UK Ministry of Defence, running through January 2027, with a potential longer-term contract valued at over £1.3 million through March 2028. The company also reported that the Defence Fund, in which it is a cornerstone investor, completed its inaugural investment in Inexorable, a member of the Meridian accelerator cohort. These developments reflect the company's transition toward longer-term customer relationships and the expansion of its sovereign defence technology portfolio. CEO Andrew Roughan is scheduled to provide further insights in an audio interview on November 25, 2026.

items.title: Futura Medical plc Receives Notification of Major Shareholding
items.summary: Futura Medical plc was notified that First Equity Limited, acting as investment manager for Armstrong Investments Limited, increased its stake in the company.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Futura Medical plc received a TR-1 notification regarding a change in major shareholdings. First Equity Limited, in its capacity as investment manager for Armstrong Investments Limited (associated with the Estate of William Black), increased its holding to 51,000,000 shares. This position represents 3.440535% of the company's voting rights, an increase from the previously reported 2.226228%. The threshold was crossed on November 23, 2026.

items.title: Alien Metals Notes Assay Results from Elizabeth Hill Silver Project
items.summary: Alien Metals Limited reported that its joint venture partner, West Coast Silver Limited, has released initial assay results from a follow-up diamond drilling program at the Elizabeth Hill Silver Project.
items.content: Alien Metals Limited announced that its joint venture partner, West Coast Silver Limited, has published assay results from the first hole of an 18-hole, approximately 1,800-meter diamond drilling program at the Elizabeth Hill Silver Project in Western Australia. Alien Metals maintains a 30% free-carried interest in the project and holds an approximate 7.0% equity stake in West Coast Silver. The drilling program is part of ongoing exploration efforts at the site.

items.title: Richmond Hill Resources Reports Initial Assay Results from Sakoose Gold Mine Drilling
items.summary: Richmond Hill Resources PLC has released the first set of assay results from its 2026 diamond drilling program at the Sakoose gold mine in Ontario, Canada.
items.content: Richmond Hill Resources PLC announced initial assay results from its 2026 diamond drilling campaign at the Sakoose gold mine. The results, derived from a first batch of priority samples, include data from holes SAK-26-001 and SAK-26-003. Hole SAK-26-001 returned 0.67 metres at 54.2 grams per tonne gold, while SAK-26-003 returned 5.84 metres at 1.16 grams per tonne gold. The company reported that 1,292 metres of the planned 1,400-metre program have been completed to date. Assays for the remaining samples from the drilling program are currently pending.

items.title: Lombard Odier Sells 1.8 Million Shares in TPXimpact
items.summary: Lombard Odier Asset Management (Europe) Limited, a firm connected to Non-Executive Director Henry Turcan, sold 1,807,723 shares of TPXimpact at 102 pence per share.
items.content: TPXimpact announced that Lombard Odier, a significant shareholder connected to Non-Executive Director Henry Turcan, sold 1,807,723 ordinary shares on November 23, 2026, at a price of 102 pence per share. Following the transaction, Lombard Odier retains a 16.6% stake in the company. The company confirmed that no financial results, guidance, or operational changes were disclosed in connection with this transaction.

items.title: Mendell Helium Provides Operational Update on Fort Dodge Prospect
items.summary: Mendell Helium reported progress on its Fort Dodge helium project, confirming the successful operation of three production wells despite ongoing challenges with water disposal and infrastructure construction.
items.content: Mendell Helium has provided an update on its operations at the Fort Dodge prospect in the United States. The company confirmed it has successfully overseen three production wells where helium is being brought to the surface. Management noted that while gas production remains inconsistent due to dewatering requirements and the ongoing construction of a helium purification facility, the ability of wells to return to production after temporary shutdowns validates their operational techniques. The company is applying these learnings to its broader expansion plans, which have been widened to include different well types and potential recompletions.

items.title: Vertu Motors Completes Acquisition of Four Hendy Group Outlets
items.summary: Vertu Motors has acquired four automotive outlets from the Hendy Group for £16.1 million, expanding its dealership network and brand representation.
items.content: Vertu Motors has completed the acquisition of the trade and certain assets of four outlets from the Hendy Group for a total cash consideration of £16.1 million. The transaction includes £1.1 million for freeholds and £6.0 million for goodwill, funded through the company's existing cash facilities. This acquisition increases Vertu's network to 201 outlets and expands its representation of Land Rover, Geely, and Jaguar franchises. While the acquired businesses are expected to contribute a loss for the remainder of the financial year ending 28 February 2027 due to seasonality, the company anticipates the deal will be earnings-enhancing in the first full year of ownership. The dealerships will be integrated into the Group's platform and rebranded to trade under the Vertu name.

items.title: Strategic Minerals Subsidiary Awarded £2 Million Grant for Redmoor Project
items.summary: Strategic Minerals plc announced that its subsidiary, Cornwall Resources Limited, received £2 million in grant funding from the KIGF to support the Redmoor Tungsten-Copper-Tin Project.
items.content: Strategic Minerals plc's wholly owned subsidiary, Cornwall Resources Limited (CRL), has been awarded £2 million in grant funding from the KIGF for the Redmoor Tungsten-Copper-Tin Project in Cornwall, UK. This funding will support the project's resource infill drilling and an integrated, accelerated full feasibility study programme. The grant represents 12.5% of the eligible project costs and will be matched by the company. Redmoor is recognized as one of the highest-grade tungsten projects globally and Europe's highest-grade undeveloped tungsten resource.

items.title: Aqualis ASA Reports Share Buyback Transactions
items.summary: Aqualis ASA has disclosed recent transactions conducted under its share buyback program.
items.content: Aqualis ASA announced the execution of transactions as part of its ongoing share buyback program. These transactions involve the acquisition or disposal of the issuer's own shares, as reported in accordance with regulatory disclosure requirements. The event reflects the company's standard capital allocation activities.

items.title: Metro Bank Holdings plc Regulatory Disclosure Regarding Offer Period
items.summary: Metro Bank Holdings plc issued a regulatory disclosure on November 25, 2026, regarding its ongoing offer period, confirming a Rule 2.6 deadline of December 3, 2026.
items.content: Metro Bank Holdings plc has provided a regulatory update concerning its ongoing offer period, which commenced on November 12, 2026. The disclosure specifies a Rule 2.6 deadline of 17:00 on December 3, 2026. This filing serves as a formal notification under the UK Takeover Code, confirming the status of the offer process for the company.

items.title: Custodian Property Income REIT Issues New Shares for Acquisition Retention
items.summary: Custodian Property Income REIT has issued over 10.9 million new ordinary shares to settle a retention related to its acquisition of Grove Court Properties (Holdings) Limited.
items.content: Custodian Property Income REIT announced the issuance of 10,940,864 new ordinary shares of 1 pence each. The issuance includes 387,390 shares designated to settle a retention obligation stemming from the company's acquisition of Grove Court Properties (Holdings) Limited, which was originally announced on 13 February 2026. The company has applied for these new shares to be admitted to the Official List of the FCA and to trading on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market. Admission is expected to become effective and dealings are scheduled to commence at 8:00 am on 30 November 2026, with the new shares ranking pari passu with existing ordinary shares.

items.title: ActiveOps PLC Announces Unaudited Results for the Six Months Ended 30 September 2026
items.summary: ActiveOps PLC reported a 19% organic SaaS revenue growth and a significant increase in adjusted EBITDA and profit before tax for the first half of the 2026 fiscal year.
items.content: ActiveOps PLC announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, highlighting a 19% organic SaaS revenue growth. The company reported an increase in adjusted EBITDA to £4.5 million, compared to £2.0 million in the same period of the previous fiscal year. Adjusted profit before tax rose by 171% to £1.9 million, up from £0.7 million in the prior year's first half. Management noted that cost savings achieved from the integration of Enlighten were reinvested into the group's sales capability, capacity, and leadership functions. Additionally, the results were bolstered by a one-off termination payment of £1.5 million.

items.title: Audioboom and Wonderloom Media Launch 'Dr. Insanity' Podcast
items.summary: Audioboom has partnered with creator economy studio Wonderloom Media to launch a new true crime podcast titled 'Dr. Insanity'.
items.content: Audioboom, a global podcast publisher, has collaborated with Wonderloom Media to release the new true crime podcast 'Dr. Insanity'. The partnership leverages Audioboom's ad-tech and monetization platform to support the distribution and commercialization of the new content. This launch aligns with the company's ongoing strategy to expand its premium network of podcasts amid rising listener demand for the true crime genre.

items.title: Trifast plc Announces Director/PDMR Shareholding
items.summary: Trifast plc reported that Rockwood Strategic plc, an investment vehicle connected to Director Nicholas Mills, purchased 125,000 ordinary shares of the company.
items.content: Trifast plc announced that Rockwood Strategic plc, an investment vehicle associated with Director Nicholas Mills, acquired 125,000 ordinary shares of the company at a price of 70p per share. The transaction took place on 20 November 2026 and was disclosed in accordance with the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Following this purchase, Nicholas Mills and his connected investment vehicles hold 28,055,000 ordinary shares, representing approximately 20.599% of the company's issued share capital.

items.title: Alumasc Group PLC Corrects Executive LTIP Share Grant Disclosure
items.summary: The Alumasc Group issued a replacement regulatory announcement to correct the volume of a previously disclosed LTIP nil-cost option grant for an executive director.
items.content: The Alumasc Group plc issued a replacement regulatory announcement to correct the volume of a nil-cost option grant for Michael Leaf, adjusting the figure from 45,905 to 42,905 shares. The company also confirmed concurrent nil-cost option grants to the CFO and another Executive Director for 42,045 and 45,950 shares, respectively. These grants, totaling 130,900 ordinary shares at 0.0 pence per share, were made on November 23, 2026, and are subject to previously established performance criteria.

items.title: Harena Rare Earths Raises £1.25 Million via Placing and Subscription
items.summary: Harena Rare Earths has successfully raised £1.25 million through a share placing and subscription to fund corporate activities and its Ampasindava project.
items.content: Harena Rare Earths has raised £1.25 million through a placing and subscription of 50 million shares at a price of 2.5p per share. This issue price represents a premium of approximately 4.2% over the company's closing mid-market share price of 2.4p on November 24, 2026. The company intends to use the proceeds to support ongoing corporate activities and its contribution to a DFC-backed development program. These funds are specifically earmarked to advance the Ampasindava ionic clay rare earth project located in Madagascar.

items.title: B90 Holdings CEO Ronny Breivik Purchases 500,000 Shares
items.summary: B90 Holdings announced that Chief Executive Officer Ronny Breivik purchased 500,000 ordinary shares of the company at a price of 2.3 pence per share.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, B90 Holdings plc reported that its Chief Executive Officer, Ronny Breivik, acquired 500,000 ordinary shares in the company. The shares were purchased at a price of 2.3 pence per share. Following this transaction, Mr. Breivik’s total interest in the company, held directly and indirectly, increased to 31,808,423 shares. This holding represents approximately 7.2% of the company's issued ordinary share capital.

items.title: Potentially AI PLC Announces Interview with Non-Executive Director Lord Dominic Johnson
items.summary: Potentially AI PLC has announced an upcoming interview with Non-Executive Director Lord Dominic Johnson, scheduled for publication on November 25, 2026.
items.content: Potentially AI PLC, an investment company focused on the artificial intelligence sector, announced that an interview with its Non-Executive Director, Lord Dominic Johnson, will be published on November 25, 2026. The interview features a discussion between Lord Johnson and CEO Oliver Yonchev regarding Lord Johnson's motivations for joining the company, his areas of excitement, and his perspective on the role of AI in government. The conversation also covers his proudest breakthroughs and his outlook on the future of the company.

items.title: Puma AIM VCT plc Discloses Investment in Chaleit Holdings plc
items.summary: Puma AIM VCT plc announced a £0.3 million investment in Chaleit Holdings plc, which was completed as part of the cybersecurity firm's IPO on the AIM market in October.
items.content: Puma AIM VCT plc reported a portfolio update on November 24, 2026, confirming a £0.3 million investment in Chaleit Holdings plc. The investment was made during Chaleit's initial public offering (IPO) on the AIM market in October 2026. Chaleit is described as a founder-led, specialist cybersecurity advisory firm focused on addressing complex security challenges through strategic advisory and technical capabilities. This disclosure highlights Chaleit's recent entry into the public markets and its inclusion in the investment portfolio of Puma AIM VCT.

items.title: Emmerson PLC Concludes Bookbuild for £1.6 Million Capital Raise
items.summary: Emmerson PLC has successfully closed its placing and subscription, raising gross proceeds of £1.6 million to support working capital requirements for its ongoing arbitration process and patenting activities.
items.content: Emmerson PLC announced the successful conclusion of its bookbuild for a capital raise, resulting in gross proceeds of £1.6 million. The company issued 164,102,513 new ordinary shares at an issue price of 0.975 pence per share. The funds are intended to provide sufficient working capital to cover the company's arbitration process and KMP patenting under current budgets. Management noted that the arbitration hearing is now scheduled for July 2028, which necessitated an extension of the company's working capital requirements. The issuance of these shares remains subject to the passing of resolutions at the company's upcoming Annual General Meeting.

items.title: Robert Walters Launches Salary Survey 2027 for Hong Kong
items.summary: Robert Walters has released its Salary Survey 2027, providing an analysis of hiring trends and salary benchmarks in the Hong Kong market.
items.content: On November 25, 2026, global talent solutions firm Robert Walters launched its Salary Survey 2027 for the Hong Kong market. The report, based on data from 600 professionals and organizations surveyed in September 2026, highlights a stabilization in the local hiring market following three years of caution. Key findings indicate that 55% of professionals are confident in the job market for 2027, while 71% of employers report challenges in finding candidates with the right skills. The survey also notes a shift in demand toward specialist and transformation-focused talent, with increased interest in contract and interim hiring as organizations navigate skills shortages in areas such as AI, data, and financial services.

items.title: UK Competition and Markets Authority Accepts Remedies in AkzoNobel-Axalta Merger
items.summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has confirmed that the remedy package proposed by AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems addresses competition concerns regarding vehicle refinish coatings in the UK.
items.content: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has accepted in principle the remedy package offered by Akzo Nobel N.V. and Axalta Coating Systems Ltd. to address competition concerns related to their proposed merger. The concerns, initially raised by the regulator on November 11, 2026, specifically focused on the market for vehicle refinish coatings in the UK. The agreed-upon remedy involves the divestment of AkzoNobel's European vehicle refinish coatings business, a measure that aligns with commitments already made to the European Commission. Both companies continue to work with the CMA toward a final conditional clearance decision and maintain their expectation that the merger will be completed by early 2027.

items.title: RBC Capital Markets Downgrades Ipsen to 'Sector Perform'
items.summary: RBC Capital Markets has downgraded its rating on Ipsen from "outperform" to "sector perform" while increasing the price target to 175 euros from 148 euros.
items.content: RBC Capital Markets downgraded Ipsen's stock rating to "sector perform" from "outperform" while simultaneously raising its price target from 148 to 175 euros. The firm cited short-term headwinds, including rising operational expenses and increased generic competition for Somatuline, as factors that may limit earnings per share growth until 2030. Additionally, the firm noted the upcoming loss of exclusivity for Cabometyx in 2029 as a long-term consideration. RBC concluded that the company's medium-term growth prospects are appropriately reflected at the current valuation of 11 times estimated 2027 earnings.

items.title: Wendel Identified as Key Stakeholder in Potential Bureau Veritas Acquisition
items.summary: Wendel, which holds a 21.4% stake in Bureau Veritas, is noted as a critical party for any potential acquisition of the company by Advent International.
items.content: Reports indicate that the investment firm Advent International is exploring a potential acquisition of Bureau Veritas, a global leader in testing, inspection, and certification. According to sources, any successful transaction would require the support of Wendel, which currently maintains a 21.4% equity stake in Bureau Veritas. The discussions are described as being at an early stage, with no certainty that an agreement will be reached. The news follows market reports that Advent is working with advisors to evaluate a potential offer, which may include the divestiture of certain Bureau Veritas assets.

items.title: Hannover Re Announces Earnings Growth Targets and Capital Market Day Outlook
items.summary: Hannover Re has announced its financial targets for the coming years, projecting a profit of at least 2.9 billion euros for 2027.
items.content: During its capital market day, Hannover Re announced a target to increase its annual profit to at least 2.9 billion euros by 2027. The company also reaffirmed its profit target of 2.7 billion euros for the current year, following a profit of 2.64 billion euros in the previous year. Additionally, the reinsurer aims to achieve a combined ratio of under 85 percent in 2027. These projections reflect the company's ongoing strategy for steady earnings growth through 2029, with expectations for at least 5% annual EBIT growth and a return on investment of approximately 3.8% in 2027.

items.title: Bureau Veritas Integrates Dassault Systèmes' 3DEXPERIENCE Platform
items.summary: Bureau Veritas has partnered with Dassault Systèmes to integrate the 3DEXPERIENCE platform into its marine, offshore, and industrial asset integrity workflows.
items.content: Bureau Veritas is incorporating Dassault Systèmes' 3DEXPERIENCE platform into its operational workflows for marine, offshore, and industrial asset integrity. This strategic partnership aims to streamline digital classification and compliance verification processes for these sectors. By leveraging the platform's capabilities, Bureau Veritas intends to enhance its efficiency in managing asset integrity and regulatory compliance.

items.title: ITC Limited's Savlon Swasth India Mission Launches #WeLoveAntibiotics Campaign
items.summary: ITC Limited has introduced a new public health campaign under its Savlon Swasth India Mission to raise awareness about responsible antibiotic use and the importance of hand hygiene.
items.content: ITC Limited, through its Savlon Swasth India Mission, has launched the #WeLoveAntibiotics campaign to address the growing public health challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR). The initiative, conceptualized by Ogilvy India, emphasizes the connection between frequent handwashing and the reduction of AMR by preventing infections. The company aims to spark conversations regarding responsible antibiotic consumption while reinforcing the role of hand hygiene in both home and hospital settings. Sameer Satpathy, Divisional Chief Executive of ITC's Personal Care Products Business, stated that the campaign is part of the company's ongoing commitment to encouraging behavioral change around hygiene.

items.title: Instant Group AG Releases Analysis on Capital Market Access via Alternative Structures
items.summary: Instant Group AG and its partner Instant IPO SE released an analysis showing that approximately 10% of companies at the 2026 Deutsches Eigenkapitalforum utilized shell, SPAC, or reverse transactions to access capital markets.
items.content: In anticipation of the 2026 Deutsches Eigenkapitalforum, Instant Group AG, in collaboration with its strategic partner Instant IPO SE, conducted an analysis of the event's participants. The study revealed that at least 26 out of 263 examined companies accessed the capital market through non-traditional routes, such as shell company, SPAC, or reverse transactions. This finding suggests that these alternative structures represent approximately 10% of the observed capital market activity. The company noted that these methods offer flexible alternatives to traditional IPOs depending on a firm's specific strategy and market environment. The analysis highlights the growing relevance of these transaction types in current capital market activity.

items.title: Commertunity AG Announces Modified Transaction Concept for Deutsche E-Metalle AG Acquisition
items.summary: Commertunity AG has updated its acquisition strategy for Deutsche E-Metalle AG, securing a 79.7% stake while adjusting capital increase plans to improve shareholder positioning.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, the board of Commertunity AG announced a decision to implement the acquisition of Deutsche E-Metalle AG (DEM) under a modified transaction concept. Through share exchange agreements with a major shareholder, the company has already secured approximately 79.7% of DEM shares, with an offer for remaining shareholders to participate until November 30, 2026. The company is also proceeding with a cash capital increase of up to 600,000 EUR, of which 390,000 EUR has already been subscribed and paid. The revised structure significantly reduces the total number of shares to 2.8 million from the originally planned 8.8 million, effectively increasing the relative capital stake of existing shareholders. Management stated that these changes are intended to accelerate the transaction and unlock potential within the acquired group.

The financing is designed to address Pliant's increasing pre-funding requirements and includes a private securitization solution for short-term, fluctuating credit exposures from its corporate credit card business. This structure provides Pliant with a scalable funding framework intended to grow alongside its business and customer base. The partnership between the two companies has spanned more than six years, with management noting that the new financing represents the next step in their collaborative relationship.

items.title: Halper Sadeh LLC Investigates Alta Equipment Group Inc. Merger
items.summary: Investor rights law firm Halper Sadeh LLC has launched an investigation into the merger between Alta Equipment Group Inc. and Jackson Group Peterbilt regarding potential breaches of fiduciary duty.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, the investor rights law firm Halper Sadeh LLC announced an investigation into the merger between Alta Equipment Group Inc. and Jackson Group Peterbilt. The investigation focuses on whether Alta and its board of directors violated federal securities laws or breached fiduciary duties during the transaction process. Specifically, the firm is examining whether the board failed to obtain the best possible price for shareholders, conducted a fair sales process, or disclosed all material information necessary for shareholders to evaluate the deal. The firm is encouraging Alta shareholders to contact them regarding their rights and options concerning the proposed acquisition.

items.title: Alta Equipment Group Announces Definitive Agreement to Acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt
items.summary: Alta Equipment Group Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt, a full-service commercial truck dealership group, for an estimated enterprise value of approximately $399 million.
items.content: Alta Equipment Group Inc. announced on November 23, 2026, that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt (JGP), a commercial truck dealership group with 34 locations in the western United States. The transaction, valued at approximately $399 million, is expected to be financed through a combination of cash and common stock. Upon completion, the acquisition will expand Alta's integrated dealership platform to include commercial trucks, material handling, and construction equipment across 119 locations in 22 U.S. states and three Canadian provinces. The company expects the deal to be accretive to earnings and cash flow within the first 12 months and to support continued deleveraging. Additionally, the transaction includes a proposed strategic investment from Viking Global Investors to assist with financing and capital efficiency.

items.title: Winamp Group S.A. Introduces New Pricing Tiers for Winamp for Artists
items.summary: Winamp Group S.A. has launched a revised pricing structure for its "Winamp for Artists" platform, introducing four distinct tiers to increase flexibility and artist acquisition.
items.content: The new pricing structure for Winamp for Artists replaces the previous free and €15.99 monthly package with four tiers: Essential (Free), Distribution+ (€5.99/month), Fan (€15.99/month), and Ultra (€19.99/month). The Essential plan allows for free music releases and royalty collection, while the Distribution+ tier enables artists to retain 100% of streaming royalties. The Fan and Ultra tiers offer additional tools for merchandising, fan relationship management, and dedicated account support. Existing subscribers to the previous €15.99 plan will maintain their current pricing for 12 months. The company aims to lower the barrier to entry for new artists and targets an average annual gross margin of approximately €250 per fully active artist by their third year.

items.title: Addex Therapeutics Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results
items.summary: Addex Therapeutics released its financial results for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, alongside a corporate update.
items.content: Addex Therapeutics reported its financial results for the third quarter and nine-month period ending September 30, 2026. The company noted that R&D expenses for the nine-month period decreased by CHF 0.5 million compared to the same period in 2025, attributed to lower outsourced R&D costs for its GABAB PAM program and reduced patent maintenance expenses. Conversely, G&A expenses rose by CHF 0.5 million during the same period, primarily due to increased staff costs. Basic and diluted loss per share for the nine-month period was CHF 0.04, an improvement from the CHF 0.05 loss reported in the prior-year period. Cash and cash equivalents remained stable at approximately CHF 2.2 million, with net sales of treasury shares and ADSs offsetting operating costs. The company also provided an update on its pipeline, including the advancement of a GABAB PAM compound for chronic cough and its 8.5% equity interest in the spin-out company Neurosterix US Holdings LLC.

items.title: Turbo Energy Receives Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Deficiency Notification
items.summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. announced it received a notification from Nasdaq indicating non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement for continued listing.
items.content: Turbo Energy, S.A. (Nasdaq: TURB) received a notification letter from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC on November 20, 2026, stating that the company is not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The deficiency is based on the company's American Depositary Shares (ADSs) closing below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days from October 9, 2026, through November 19, 2026. This notification does not result in immediate delisting and does not affect the company's day-to-day operations. Turbo Energy has been granted an initial 180-calendar-day period, ending May 19, 2027, to regain compliance. To restore compliance, the company's ADSs must maintain a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for a minimum of 10 consecutive business days during this period.

items.title: Solwers Subsidiary Secures Planning Contract for Office and Hotel Project in Finland
items.summary: A subsidiary of Solwers has been selected to provide planning services for a new office and hotel development project in Finland.
items.content: A subsidiary of Solwers has been awarded a contract to manage the planning for a new office and hotel project in Finland. The project involves architectural and technical consulting services, which are core components of the Solwers group's service offerings. This development aligns with the company's strategy of providing specialized engineering and consulting services for the built environment. The announcement was reported on November 24, 2026.

items.title: Mariatorp Oy's Shareholding in Remedy Entertainment Exceeds 10 Percent
items.summary: Remedy Entertainment Plc reported that the shareholding of Mariatorp Oy has crossed the 10 percent ownership threshold.
items.content: Remedy Entertainment Plc has announced that Mariatorp Oy's shareholding in the company has exceeded the 10 percent threshold. This disclosure follows standard regulatory notification requirements regarding significant changes in major shareholdings. Mariatorp Oy is a Finnish company that has previously been identified as a significant holder of Remedy Entertainment shares.

items.title: NoHo Partners to Acquire Majority Stake in Søpavillonen's Restaurant Operations
items.summary: NoHo Partners has announced an agreement to acquire a majority stake in the restaurant operations of Søpavillonen.
items.content: NoHo Partners is expanding its Nordic portfolio by acquiring a majority stake in the restaurant operations of Søpavillonen. This strategic move aligns with the company's ongoing growth strategy in the Northern European hospitality market. The acquisition involves taking a controlling interest in the venue's dining and entertainment services. Further details regarding the transaction terms were not disclosed in the initial report.

items.title: Herantis Pharma Sets Price for €15 Million Share Offering
items.summary: Herantis Pharma Oyj has finalized the pricing for a share issuance aimed at raising €15 million.
items.content: Herantis Pharma Oyj has announced the pricing for a new share issuance, with the company set to raise €15 million in capital. This financing event represents a significant step for the clinical-stage biotechnology firm as it continues its development of disease-modifying therapies for neurodegenerative conditions. The announcement was reported on November 25, 2026.

items.title: RedHill Biopharma Receives 16-Month U.S. Patent Extension for Rebyota
items.summary: RedHill Biopharma announced that the USPTO granted a 478-day patent term extension for Rebyota, extending its U.S. patent protection through November 30, 2036.
items.content: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. has been awarded a 478-day patent term extension for U.S. Patent No. 9,675,648, which covers the product Rebyota. This extension moves the patent's expiration date from August 10, 2035, to November 30, 2036. The company stated that this development enhances the long-term commercial potential of the asset. This news follows RedHill's recent strategic transformation, which included the acquisition of two FDA-approved gastrointestinal products with combined 2025 net sales of $37.5 million.

items.title: Lifeward Unveils Next-Generation AlterG Anti-Gravity Treadmill at MEDICA 2026
items.summary: Lifeward introduced the AlterG NEO+ Evolve, the latest evolution of its AlterG Anti-Gravity Treadmill platform, at the MEDICA 2026 medical trade fair.
items.content: Lifeward Ltd. announced the unveiling of its next-generation AlterG Anti-Gravity Treadmill platform, the AlterG NEO+ Evolve, at the MEDICA 2026 medical trade fair held in Düsseldorf, Germany, from November 16 to 19, 2026. The new system represents the latest evolution of the company's AlterG NEO+ platform, which utilizes pressurized air technology to reduce gravitational load for rehabilitation and training. The company showcased the technology to international partners and industry professionals at the event.

items.title: BioLineRx Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Update
items.summary: BioLineRx announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and entered into a $5.6 million royalty monetization agreement regarding its APHEXDA asset.
items.content: BioLineRx reported its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a corporate update. The company entered into a $5.6 million royalty monetization transaction with Soleus Capital, involving the sale of its 14.4% net royalty interest in future net sales of APHEXDA under its existing license agreement with Ayrmid. BioLineRx will retain its rights to future commercial milestone payments under the Ayrmid agreement. Management expects the transaction to close on or about November 30, 2026, and believes the proceeds will fund the company's projected cash requirements into the second half of 2027. Additionally, the company presented data at the 2026 ESMO Annual Congress demonstrating synergy between its lead asset, GLIX1, and PARP inhibitors in HR-proficient ovarian cancer.

items.title: Gix Internet Ltd. Announces Portfolio Company Quantum X Labs Signs R&D Agreement with Elbit Systems
items.summary: Gix Internet Ltd. reported that its portfolio company, Quantum X Labs Inc., has entered into a joint R&D program development agreement with Elbit Systems to collaborate on technological solutions.
items.content: Gix Internet Ltd., which holds an approximately 13% stake in Quantum X Labs Inc., announced that the latter has signed a joint R&D program development agreement with Elbit Systems. The collaboration aims to integrate Quantum X Labs' proprietary quantum technology expertise with Elbit Systems' C4I & Cyber division. The partnership is intended to support the development of secure applications and explore potential commercial opportunities. This agreement reflects Quantum X Labs' strategy to work with established industry leaders to translate its quantum technologies into real-world applications.

items.title: HUB Cyber Security Appoints Richard Paolone as CEO and Joseph Tung as Chairperson
items.summary: HUB Cyber Security Ltd. has appointed Richard Paolone as Chief Executive Officer and Joseph Tung as Chairperson of the Board as part of an ongoing corporate reorganization.
items.content: HUB Cyber Security Ltd. announced the appointment of Richard Paolone as Chief Executive Officer, effective November 22, 2026, and Joseph Tung as Chairperson of the Board. Mr. Paolone, who joined the board in October 2026, succeeds the previous leadership structure as part of a comprehensive restructuring effort. The company stated that this reorganization is intended to improve liquidity, simplify its organizational structure, reduce operating costs, and strengthen corporate governance. Additionally, Ms. Renah Persofsky has stepped down as Active Chairperson but will remain on the board, while Mr. Shlomo Bibas resigned from the board effective November 22, 2026. The company continues to explore strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value.

items.title: BULGOLD Inc. to Present Lutila Gold Project Strategy at Resourcing Tomorrow Conference
items.summary: BULGOLD Inc. announced it will present its exploration strategy and latest developments for the Lutila Gold Project at the upcoming Resourcing Tomorrow conference in London.
items.content: BULGOLD Inc. will showcase its exploration strategy and recent progress at the 100%-owned Lutila Gold Project in central Slovakia during the Resourcing Tomorrow conference, scheduled for December 1-3, 2026, in London, United Kingdom. The company's work at the project has identified a low-sulfidation epithermal system with multiple vein structures and high-grade gold surface samples. Management is currently evaluating a proposed scissor-hole drilling program to test the targeted vein system at depth. This presentation aims to provide stakeholders with an update on the company's geological interpretation and exploration objectives.

items.title: Enlivex Schedules FDA RMAT Meeting for Allocetra™ Clinical Development
items.summary: Enlivex Ltd. announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has scheduled a Type B Initial Comprehensive Multidisciplinary Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) meeting for December 8, 2026.
items.content: Enlivex Ltd. has scheduled a Type B Initial Comprehensive Multidisciplinary RMAT meeting with the FDA for December 8, 2026, to align on the clinical development path for its lead product candidate, Allocetra™, as it progresses from Phase IIb toward a potential BLA submission. The company also reported 12-month data from its Phase I/IIa trial in knee osteoarthritis, which showed that 79.2% of patients aged 64 and older in the Allocetra™ group achieved a clinically meaningful response, compared to 47.6% in the placebo group. CEO Dr. Oren Hershkovitz stated that the meeting represents a formal step in coordinating the development plan under the company's RMAT designation, building on the durable benefits observed in the Phase I/IIa study.

items.title: PolyPid Receives FDA Approval for BACFENSSI
items.summary: PolyPid Ltd. has received FDA approval for its lead product candidate, BACFENSSI, marking the company's first-ever regulatory approval for a therapeutic product.
items.content: PolyPid Ltd. announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved BACFENSSI (doxycycline hyclate) for the reduction of surgical site infections in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 45 kilograms undergoing colorectal surgery with incision lengths greater than 20 centimeters. This milestone represents the company's first FDA-approved product. The treatment utilizes PolyPid's proprietary technology to provide local, prolonged release of antibiotics at the surgical site. Commercialization in the United States will be handled by partner Azurity Pharmaceuticals, with a launch anticipated in early 2027. The product is eligible for a total of eight years of regulatory exclusivity, combining three years for new clinical investigations and five years under its Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) designation.

items.title: Silynxcom Reports Over $1 Million in Orders Since September
items.summary: Silynxcom Ltd. announced it has received over $1 million in purchase orders for its tactical communication solutions since September 1, 2026, including $800,000 in previously unannounced orders.
items.content: Silynxcom Ltd. reported that it has secured purchase orders totaling more than $1 million since September 1, 2026. Of this total, approximately $800,000 represents new orders that had not been previously disclosed. Government entities accounted for over 40% of the orders, amounting to more than $440,000, while the remainder came from international defense companies and distribution partners. CEO Nir Klein stated that these orders demonstrate the reliability of the company's products in mission-critical environments and reflect growing reliance from government and defense customers. The company views these results as a positive indicator for its performance heading into the end of 2026.

items.title: Polyrizon Ltd. Announces Definitive Agreement to Acquire 51% Controlling Stake in Arrow Aviation Ltd.
items.summary: Polyrizon Ltd. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a 51% controlling interest in the Israeli aviation company Arrow Aviation Ltd. for approximately $17.2 million.
items.content: Polyrizon Ltd. announced a multi-component transaction to acquire a 51% controlling stake in Arrow Aviation Ltd., an Israeli company specializing in executive aircraft operations, air ambulance, and medical evacuation services. The deal is valued at approximately $17.2 million and involves a $5.4 million cash investment, the assumption of a $4 million debt obligation related to Arrow Aviation's acquisition of RBK Brands Ltd., and the issuance of service shares. Polyrizon expects to consolidate Arrow Aviation's financial results upon the closing of the transaction, which is subject to customary conditions and expected to be completed by December 31, 2026. Following the acquisition, Polyrizon will be entitled to appoint three directors to Arrow Aviation's five-member board, and the agreement includes put and call options for the remaining 49% stake exercisable between the second and fifth anniversaries of the closing.

items.title: Maris-Tech Completes Initial Milestones for $10 Million Airborne Video Systems Order
items.summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. has successfully completed the initial milestones, valued at approximately $633,000, for its previously announced $10 million airborne video systems contract.
items.content: Maris-Tech Ltd. announced the successful completion of initial milestones under its largest-ever order, a $10 million contract to develop and supply advanced video systems for next-generation manned airborne platforms. The completed milestones are valued at approximately $633,000. This multi-year project, which is being conducted in collaboration with Magam Safety Ltd., remains on track with the company's plans. Maris-Tech expects to complete deliveries representing approximately $7.1 million of the total order value by the end of 2028.

items.title: Regentis Biomaterials Launches GelrinC Surgical Training Program in Warsaw
items.summary: Regentis Biomaterials has initiated a surgical training program in Warsaw, Poland, to instruct Israeli orthopedic surgeons on the use of its GelrinC implant for knee cartilage repair.
items.content: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd. announced the launch of a surgical training program in Warsaw, Poland, designed to provide Israeli orthopedic surgeons with expertise in the GelrinC surgical procedure. The initiative is a strategic step to support the company's commercialization efforts in Israel, where surgeons have begun performing the procedure at local clinics and hospitals. GelrinC is a cell-free, off-the-shelf hydrogel implant used for the treatment of focal articular knee cartilage injuries. The product currently holds an AMAR medical device registration certificate from Israel's Ministry of Health and has received CE Mark approval in Europe. This training program aims to expand the network of qualified physicians capable of performing the procedure as the company advances its commercial strategy.

items.title: Silexion Therapeutics Opens First Two Clinical Sites in Germany for Phase 2/3 Trial of SIL204
items.summary: Silexion Therapeutics has expanded its Phase 2/3 clinical trial for SIL204 in locally advanced pancreatic cancer by opening two new sites in Germany.
items.content: Silexion Therapeutics Corp. announced that two clinical sites in Germany are now open to enroll patients for its Phase 2/3 trial of SIL204, a treatment for locally advanced pancreatic cancer. The new sites include Ulm University Hospital, led by Prof. Dr. med. Thomas Seufferlein, and TUM University Hospital in Munich, led by Prof. Dr. med. Hana Algül. The trial focuses on newly diagnosed patients with KRAS-mutated, locally advanced pancreatic cancer that cannot be surgically removed. The study utilizes a dual-dosing approach, combining local tumor injections with systemic administration to target both the primary tumor and potential microscopic spread.

items.title: Eco Wave Power Receives Letter of Intent for 100 MW Wave Energy Project in Africa
items.summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) announced that its U.S. subsidiary has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) from an African electricity utility to explore the development of up to 100 MW of wave energy capacity.
items.content: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) has received a Letter of Intent (LOI) from an unnamed electricity utility in Africa regarding the potential exploration and development of up to 100 MW of wave energy capacity. This development follows the company's previous feasibility study at the Port of Ngqura in South Africa, which identified a technical potential for approximately 8.3 MW of installed capacity. The company characterizes this new LOI as a significant step in its African market expansion strategy, providing an opportunity to evaluate its proprietary wave energy technology at a larger scale. The announcement was made on November 24, 2026.

items.title: Trustee Appointed for Arbitral Proceedings Regarding Minority Share Redemption in Citycon Oyj
items.summary: A trustee has been appointed to represent the interests of minority shareholders in the ongoing arbitral proceedings concerning the redemption of shares in Citycon Oyj.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, it was reported that a trustee has been appointed for the arbitral proceedings regarding the redemption of minority shares in Citycon Oyj. This appointment is a procedural step in the legal process concerning the company's share redemption. The trustee will represent the interests of the minority shareholders throughout the arbitration.

items.title: SciSparc Announces 1-for-5 Reverse Share Split
items.summary: SciSparc Ltd. has announced a 1-for-5 reverse share split of its ordinary shares, effective at the market open on November 27, 2026.
items.content: SciSparc Ltd. announced its intention to implement a 1-for-5 reverse share split of its issued and outstanding ordinary shares. The split is scheduled to become effective at the market open on November 27, 2026, with the company's shares continuing to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the existing ticker symbol "SPRC" on a split-adjusted basis. The action will affect all shareholders uniformly and is not expected to alter any shareholder's percentage of ownership interest, excluding minor adjustments related to fractional shares. Following the split, the number of issued and outstanding ordinary shares is expected to be reduced from 2,628,447 to approximately 525,689.

items.title: Vidac Pharma Holding PLC Executive Director Sells Shares
items.summary: Dr. Max Herzberg, a board member of Vidac Pharma Holding PLC, sold company shares on the Xetra exchange on November 20, 2026.
items.content: Dr. Max Herzberg, a member of the board of Vidac Pharma Holding PLC, sold company shares on the Xetra exchange on November 20, 2026. The transaction involved the sale of shares at a price of 0.19 EUR per share, totaling 3,800 EUR. This disclosure was made in accordance with Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation (MAR). The company stated that net proceeds from such activities may be used for general investment purposes and potential future capital measures, subject to market and company conditions.

items.title: MySize Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Stockholders' Equity Requirement
items.summary: MySize, Inc. announced that it has received notification from Nasdaq confirming it has regained compliance with the minimum stockholders' equity requirement for continued listing.
items.content: MySize, Inc. (NASDAQ: MYSZ) received written notification from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC on November 20, 2026, confirming that the company has regained compliance with the $2.5 million minimum stockholders' equity requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). The determination was based on the company's Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026, which reported stockholders' equity of approximately $3.37 million. Nasdaq has officially closed the matter relating to this specific listing requirement.

items.title: Rail Vision Eliminates Outstanding Warrants in Exchange for Ordinary Shares
items.summary: Rail Vision Ltd. has reached an agreement with an institutional investor to cancel 163,214 outstanding warrants containing anti-dilution and price protection provisions in exchange for 120,000 restricted ordinary shares.
items.content: Rail Vision Ltd. announced an agreement to eliminate all of its outstanding warrants that included anti-dilution and price protection provisions. In exchange for the full cancellation of 163,214 warrants and all related rights, the company will issue 120,000 restricted ordinary shares to an institutional investor. The newly issued shares represent approximately 4.9% of the company's issued and outstanding share capital following the transaction. Management stated that the move is intended to simplify the company's capital table and provide greater flexibility to pursue future financing alternatives based on market conditions.

items.title: Spinnova Commences Production Runs at Eteläportti Demo Factory
items.summary: Spinnova has officially started production runs at its Eteläportti demo factory in Jyväskylä, Finland, with initial batches ready for customer delivery.
items.content: Spinnova has initiated production runs at its Eteläportti demo factory in Jyväskylä, Finland, marking a key step in the company's operational ramp-up. The first production batches have been completed and are prepared for customer delivery. This milestone follows the company's acquisition of the facility in October 2025 and successful test runs conducted earlier in 2026. The factory is now being systematically ramped up toward broader production, with results confirming the functionality and flexibility of the production concept.

items.title: NurExone Reports Preclinical Data Showing Exosome Localization to Injured Spinal Cord Tissue
items.summary: NurExone Biologic Inc. announced new preclinical findings demonstrating that its proprietary exosomes can successfully localize to injured spinal cord tissue following minimally invasive administration.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, NurExone Biologic Inc. released new preclinical data evaluating the biodistribution of its proprietary naïve exosomes, which serve as the biological carriers for its lead investigational product, ExoPTEN. The study showed that exosome-associated fluorescent signals were detected at the site of spinal cord injury within 15 minutes of intrathecal administration, with signals observed in the grey matter below the injury site after one hour. The company stated that these findings provide biological evidence that its exosomes can move beyond the surrounding cerebrospinal fluid into the injured tissue. Management indicated that these results support the company's ongoing efforts to advance its regulatory roadmap toward future clinical trials.

items.title: Beyond Oil Launches Frying Management Ecosystem for Professional Kitchens
items.summary: Beyond Oil Ltd. has introduced a new frying management ecosystem that integrates its proprietary filter powder with a digital application, professional kitchen tools, and a new bulk product format.
items.content: Beyond Oil Ltd. announced the launch of a comprehensive frying management ecosystem designed for professional kitchens and industrial frying markets. The new offering combines the company's proprietary filter powder with a digital frying management application, seven complementary kitchen products, and a new 10 kg bulk format. This ecosystem is intended to support larger restaurant chains and franchise groups by providing standardized procedures, tools, and management visibility. The company stated that this move marks its evolution from a single-product supplier to a broader frying management partner, with the new consumable products expected to drive repeat sales and simplify procurement for customers.

items.title: Ellomay Capital Reports Financial Results for the Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. announced its unaudited interim consolidated financial results for the third quarter and first nine months of 2026, highlighting growth in revenue and significant profit figures.
items.content: Ellomay Capital reported revenues of approximately €15 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to €12.7 million in the same period of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the company recorded a profit of approximately €59.5 million, up from €8.5 million in the prior-year period. Total assets reached approximately €993.2 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to €843.5 million at the end of 2025. The results include the impact of the sale of Ellomay Luzon Energy in May 2026, which was presented as discontinued operations. Additionally, the company reported EBITDA of approximately €126.5 million for the nine-month period, before accounting for a €27.8 million tax on income related to the divestiture.

items.title: Braiin Limited Furnishes FY2026 Pro Forma Combined Financial Information
items.summary: Braiin Limited has released pro forma condensed combined financial information for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, to provide a twelve-month view of business performance.
items.content: Braiin Limited furnished a report on Form 6-K with the SEC detailing pro forma condensed combined financial information for the financial year ended June 30, 2026. The pro forma data presents the company's results as if the acquisitions of the VIS group, the Vega group, and Connect Simple Pty Ltd had occurred on July 1, 2025. The company reported pro forma revenue of US$78.3 million for the full twelve-month period, compared to the reported revenue of US$25.9 million which only included the acquired businesses for approximately 4.5 months. Additionally, the company disclosed a pro forma loss for the year of US$24.1 million, or US$0.12 per share, compared to the reported loss of US$24.7 million, or US$0.15 per share. Management stated that this presentation is intended to allow investors to better compare the performance of the Braiin Group as currently constituted.

items.title: Micropolis Receives NYSE American Extension to File Delayed Annual Report
items.summary: Micropolis AI Robotics has been granted an extension by NYSE Regulation to file its delayed 2025 Form 20-F annual report by December 13, 2026.
items.content: Micropolis AI Robotics (NYSE American: MCRP) announced that it received approval from NYSE Regulation for an extension to regain compliance with continued listing standards. The company, which failed to file its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, by the original May 15, 2026 deadline, has been granted a new cure period ending December 13, 2026. The extension follows the expiration of an initial six-month cure period on November 15, 2026. While the company is working with auditors to complete the filing, it noted there is no assurance that it will meet the new deadline or ultimately regain full compliance. NYSE Regulation will monitor the company's progress during this period and may initiate delisting proceedings if milestones are not met.

items.content: On November 24, 2026, BTIG analyst Clark Lampen reaffirmed a "Buy" rating for AppLovin Corporation. The firm also maintained its existing price target of $450 for the company's shares, signaling continued confidence in the stock's performance.

items.title: Dowty to Open £19 Million Innovation Centre Backed by GE Aerospace
items.summary: Dowty, a GE Aerospace company, is set to open a new £19 million innovation center in the UK to advance propeller and Open Fan technologies.
items.content: Dowty, a subsidiary of GE Aerospace, is establishing a new innovation center in the United Kingdom. The project is supported by a £19 million investment from GE Aerospace. The facility is intended to accelerate the research and development of advanced propeller systems and Open Fan propulsion technologies.

items.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard Reports Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results and Provides Update on Żabka Tender Offer
items.summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard reported its fiscal second-quarter results for 2027 and announced that its tender offer for Żabka Group has become unconditional following regulatory approvals.
items.content: Alimentation Couche-Tard reported a profit of $691.3 million, or 75 cents per share, for the second quarter ended October 11, 2026, compared to $740.6 million, or 79 cents per share, in the same period last year. Adjusted earnings were 84 cents per share, exceeding analyst expectations of 80 cents. Revenue rose to $22.54 billion from $17.87 billion, driven by higher fuel selling prices. CEO Alex Miller noted improved performance in the U.S. business, including sequential increases in same-store sales and merchandise margin expansion. Additionally, the company confirmed its voluntary tender offer for Poland's Żabka Group is now unconditional following the receipt of all regulatory approvals. The offer price of 32 Polish złoty per share will not be increased, and the transaction is expected to close on December 7, 2026.

items.summary: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. will join Whitley Penn and WPWealth to host a complimentary webinar on December 16, 2026, focusing on economic outlooks and year-end financial planning.
items.content: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc. is scheduled to participate in a complimentary webinar on December 16, 2026, alongside Whitley Penn and WPWealth. items.title: Leadership Change at Marathon Petroleum's Savage Branch Wildlife Reserve
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum announced a transition in volunteer leadership at its WHC-certified Savage Branch Wildlife Reserve in Catlettsburg, Kentucky.
items.content: Marathon Petroleum has announced a change in volunteer leadership at the Savage Branch Wildlife Reserve, a long-running conservation site owned by the company's Catlettsburg refinery. After 16 years of service, the lead volunteer is retiring and passing responsibilities to an environmental specialist at the refinery. The reserve, which is managed by employee volunteers, reflects the company's ongoing commitment to environmental stewardship and community engagement.

items.title: FedEx Operations Impacted by US Aviation Suspension
items.summary: FedEx's air cargo and mail operations were disrupted following a general suspension of flight departures across the United States.
items.content: FedEx experienced operational disruptions to its freight and mail transport services due to a broad suspension of flight departures in the United States. The event, which also affected other major logistics carriers like UPS, was characterized as a significant interruption to national aviation infrastructure. The company's network was directly impacted by the grounding of flights, highlighting the vulnerability of its integrated air-ground delivery system to systemic aviation issues.

items.title: Cloudflare Director Carl Ledbetter Sells Shares
items.summary: Cloudflare Director Carl Ledbetter sold 5,000 shares of the company's Class A common stock on November 24, 2026.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Cloudflare Director Carl Ledbetter sold 5,000 shares of the company's Class A common stock for a total value of $1,436,087. The transaction was executed pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan that the director had adopted on February 25, 2026. Following this sale, the director maintains control over 883,514 Class A common shares, consisting of 20,441 shares held directly and 863,073 shares held indirectly.

items.content: S&P Dow Jones Indices, a division of S&P Global, announced that Centuri Holdings Inc. (NYSE: CTRI) will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index. Centuri Holdings will replace DoubleVerify Holdings Inc. (NYSE: DV), which is being acquired by Nielsen Holdings. The change is scheduled to take effect prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.

items.summary: Datadog, Inc. director Alexis Le-Quoc sold 44,400 shares of company stock for approximately $7.49 million, according to a recent SEC filing.
items.content: According to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) dated November 24, 2026, Datadog director Alexis Le-Quoc sold 44,400 shares of common stock. The transaction occurred on November 23, 2026, at an average price of $168.7259 per share, totaling approximately $7.49 million. Such disclosures are required by the SEC for company insiders when changes in their holdings occur.

items.title: FIBRA Prologis Recasts Credit Facility, Doubling Capacity to $1 Billion
items.summary: FIBRA Prologis has successfully recast its unsecured, sustainability-linked revolving credit facility, increasing its capacity to $1 billion with improved borrowing terms.
items.content: FIBRA Prologis, a related entity of Prologis, Inc., announced the restructuring of its unsecured, sustainability-linked revolving credit facility. The credit line capacity has been doubled from US$500 million to US$1 billion, with an additional accordion feature allowing for potential expansion to US$1.5 billion, subject to lender approval. The new facility features an initial maturity in February 2030, with two one-year extension options. Borrowing costs have been reduced, with the spread now set at 100 basis points over the benchmark rate, a 25 basis point improvement. The agreement also introduces KPI-based pricing adjustments and a new rating-based facility fee structure.

items.title: New York State Common Retirement Fund Weighs $4 Billion CFO Involving Blackstone Funds
items.summary: The New York State Common Retirement Fund is reportedly considering a $4 billion collateralized fund obligation (CFO) backed by its stakes in private credit funds, including those managed by Blackstone.
items.content: The New York State Common Retirement Fund is exploring a roughly $4 billion collateralized fund obligation (CFO) backed by its interests in approximately 20 private credit funds. The portfolio includes stakes in funds managed by Blackstone, Blue Owl, Sixth Street, Pimco, and Ares. While the pension fund has reportedly initiated steps to provide potential buyers with access to fund information, the deal remains in the consideration phase and could still change or fail to materialize. This transaction would be notable as a rare instance of a limited partner, rather than an asset manager, structuring a CFO.

items.title: Apollo Reported to be in Talks Regarding Financing for Potential Global Payments Acquisition
items.summary: Apollo is reportedly among the private equity firms in discussions to help finance GTCR's potential take-private acquisition of Global Payments.
items.content: According to reports citing unnamed sources, Apollo is in discussions to assist in financing a potential take-private acquisition of payments processor Global Payments by the private equity firm GTCR. The potential transaction is estimated to be worth approximately $50 billion. As of the report, the discussions are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached. Representatives for Apollo declined to comment on the matter.
